jobs.title: Global Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery
jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is hiring a Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery to make high-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale.

When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner. You will lead our most complex customer deployments, turn what works, technically and organizationally, into clear playbooks, and build the partner delivery capacity that lets more customers succeed with Dust in 2027 and beyond.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You will lead and grow Dust’s global AI Deployment team, stay directly involved in our most important deployments, and build the methods, standards, and partner network that allow delivery to scale without depending on you for every engagement.

You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to connect what customers want to achieve with how deployments are planned, delivered, and measured.

This is a chance to define how an AI-native company delivers transformation: what an exceptional deployment looks like, how value is measured, and how partners become delivery teams our customers trust.

What you’ll do

Lead and grow the global AI Deployment team

  • Lead Dust’s existing global AI Deployment team and set its direction, priorities, and standards.

  • Hire and develop deployment leaders and practitioners as customer demand grows.

  • Shape roles, career paths, and coverage across regions, customer segments, and deployment types.

  • Coach the team through complex customer situations and hold a consistently high bar for the work.

  • Set up the operating rhythms, capacity planning, and reporting the function needs to scale.

Define how Dust deployments are delivered

  • Build one deployment method, from discovery through handoff, that Dust and partner teams can both follow to the same standard.

  • Define which deployments Dust should lead, which a partner can deliver well, and how work moves between the two.

  • Set clear entry and exit criteria and go-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go-live quality, and customer satisfaction.

  • Run regular delivery reviews, spot at-risk engagements early, and bring the right Dust and partner people together quickly when a deployment is blocked.

  • Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable playbooks, templates, and reference architectures, and recurring friction into clear input for Product and Engineering.

Lead AI transformation with strategic customers

  • Personally lead complex, high-priority, and first-of-their-kind deployments, from scoping to lasting adoption, bringing in Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering when complexity or risk calls for it.

  • Help customer leaders define what AI transformation means for their organization: map how teams work today and identify the workflows where agents can create the most value.

  • Align executives, IT, security, and business teams on goals, use cases, and success measures, with a baseline before launch and measured impact after.

  • Design change programs for each deployment: executive sponsorship, communication plans, role-based enablement, and clear adoption milestones.

  • Develop AI operators and champions inside customer teams, and help customers update ways of working, governance, and ownership so agents become part of how teams operate.

  • Track adoption after launch, act quickly when teams aren’t changing how they work, and hand off to Customer Success with a clear picture of what comes next.

Build a high-quality partner delivery network

  • Work with Partnerships to assess partners’ delivery capability, technical depth, and customer readiness.

  • Start with a small, carefully selected group of partner practitioners and grow capacity as quality is proven.

  • Co-create onboarding, training, certification, and train-the-trainer programs so partners can develop their own Dust experts.

  • Co-deliver early partner engagements, then help partners progress toward delivering independently, leading adoption, not just implementation.

  • Ensure customers experience Dust and its partners as one aligned team, with clear responsibilities on every engagement.

Requirements

  • You have at least 6 years of experience leading and developing customer-facing deployment or delivery teams, ideally across multiple regions or customer segments and through periods of fast change.

  • You have led complex enterprise deployments or transformation programs and delivered measurable customer outcomes.

  • You have built or significantly improved a deployment methodology, professional services model, or delivery function, adding the structure needed to scale without unnecessary process.

  • You have led organizational change alongside technology rollouts, and built champion networks or adoption plans that changed how teams work after the project ended.

    You don’t need to be a machine-learning engineer. Beyond that, we care more about evidence that you have built high-performing delivery systems than about a perfect sequence of titles.

  • You understand how systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners staff, deliver, and grow a practice, and you have built enablement or certification programs that created lasting capability in teams you didn’t manage.

  • You have turned around engagements at risk from scope, staffing, technical complexity, or stakeholder misalignment, and you know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to reset.

  • You are credible with customer executives, partner leaders, and technical practitioners, and you communicate clearly with all of them.

  • You are a hands-on, low-ego leader with a builder’s instinct: you would rather solve the problem than hand off a recommendation.

  • You are comfortable traveling to customers and partners when it matters most.

AI and technical credibility

  • Advise customers on where AI agents can create meaningful value and where they can’t yet, and explain why to technical teams, business leaders, and executives.

  • Understand how agents work in practice: prompting, context, tool use, retrieval, evaluations, reliability, and cost.

  • Challenge a deployment plan’s assumptions about integrations, data connectors, authentication, permissions, security, and production readiness, and discuss the trade-offs with engineers.

  • Design evaluation approaches that connect AI performance to customer and business outcomes.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words

Within QARA, you oversee Good Clinical Practice compliance across Resilience’s sponsored studies and studies conducted with pharmaceutical partners. You combine clinical quality, data integrity and system qualification, working closely with the teams running studies and building data workflows.

Your impact

You help keep studies inspection-ready, data reliable and traceable, and compliance embedded in everyday work. Your role is to safeguard the framework and help teams apply it, rather than produce the data yourself.

Your day-to-day work

  • Oversee study GCP compliance, manage deviations and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and conduct quality and Trial Master File (TMF) reviews.

  • Maintain inspection readiness and support CRO oversight in line with ICH E6(R3).

  • Qualify systems, assess test environments and review data extractions, audit trails and Data Management Plans.

  • Work with Data and Clinical teams to build compliance into data workflows from the outset.

  • Maintain clinical quality procedures, train teams and monitor regulatory developments.

This is not a site-monitoring, data-engineering, study-project-management or routine clinical data-production role.

✨ Your Team

Here, we don’t work in silos. You’ll join an agile structure where compliance is truly a team sport:

  • Your Manager: Yasmine, the guardian of regulatory compliance for our medical devices. She will share her strategic vision of the healthcare sector with you and will be your go-to for the most sensitive decisions.

  • Your core team: A trio of passionate experts. They’re your daily contacts for everything related to the quality management system, technical files, and audit preparation.

  • The team’s little extra: A unique context where safety, clinical, and regulatory aspects come together to better serve patients, led by a team that combines rigor and kindness.

You’ll own what members touch every day: onboarding, the core app surfaces, the moments that turn a first-time visitor into someone who trusts us with their health. Your work has to be delightful and reliable on real devices, for people who decide in minutes whether to trust us.

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and forward-thinking Senior Automation Engineer to design, implement, and optimize automation systems at our production site, the model for our future global manufacturing sites.
You’ll lead automation projects that enable cost-effective, high-volume, and defense-grade production through robotics, digital integration, and lean processes.

Responsibilities

Automation Systems

  • Design and deploy automated solutions across key manufacturing and test processes.

  • Translate manual tasks into robust automated stations (robotics, sensors, actuators, software).

  • Own equipment specifications, commissioning, and validation with suppliers and integrators.

Performance & Reliability

  • Maximize OEE through improved uptime, performance, and first-pass yield.

  • Analyze real-time data and fault logs to drive continuous improvement.

  • Support maintenance and production teams in troubleshooting and system optimization.

Digital Integration

  • Connect automation platforms to ERP/MES for live traceability and performance data.

  • Build OEE dashboards and enable predictive maintenance through data and IoT tools.

  • Contribute to digital twin and simulation projects for capacity and layout planning.

Innovation & Standardization

  • Evaluate and prototype new automation and robotics technologies.

  • Standardize automation architectures and documentation for replication in future factories.

  • Train technical staff and provide user-friendly system documentation.

Candidate Requirements

  • Degree in Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or equivalent.

  • 5+ years experience in manufacturing automation (design, commissioning, optimization).

  • Strong command of robotics, PLCs, sensors, motion systems, and automation safety standards (CE).

  • Interest in Industry 4.0, collaborative robotics, and machine learning applications.

  • Proven experience deploying reliable, high-availability systems.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English, capable of leading diverse principals – from junior members to senior executives.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Hej Senior Data Engineer!

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Data Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

We’re looking for senior data engineers who want to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences.

As part of the Data & Analytics team in Core Business Range, your new job will contribute to develop and deploy data products, strengthening the common ways of working. You will work closely with teams across the Inter IKEA group and with our partners. You are passionate about the digital transformation and see process and solution development as a key to make life easier for the many people and make a clear footprint in line with the IKEA direction.

On a typical day as a senior data engineer, you will:

    Transform data into an analyzable format (ETL/ELT) to deliver business benefits.
    Develop and maintain infrastructures for data sourcing, processing, and sharing.
    Optimize, test, and implement tools to enhance data quality and monitor drift and decay.
    Manage data integration, processing, and modeling.
    Provide APIs for standardized data sharing and access.
    Translate business data needs into technical solutions and architectures.
    Ensure compliance with security, legal, and delivery standards.
    Support and coach teams in data-driven development.
    Document and share knowledge on data infrastructure within IKEA.
    Apply best practices in CI/CD and maintain cost-effective solutions.



What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as Senior Data Engineer requires you to have:

    Expertise in PySpark, Python and SQL: essential for developing efficient data pipelines and handling large-scale data processing.
    Experience in levering AI assistants like github copilot and databricks genie code.  
    You have solid knowledge of industry-standard software development languages and a deep understanding of on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures.
    You are a proactive team player who takes ownership, builds cross-functional relationships with senior peers, and enjoys mentoring junior colleagues.
    You are a curious, world-class problem solver passionate about continuous learning and innovation.
    At least five years of experience in data engineering.
    You embody IKEA’s values in both thought and action. Explore what it means to work at IKEA here: https://en-global-jobs.about.ikea.com/lifeatikea



Be yourself, a Data Engineer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.



We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 25th of October. This is a permanent position based in Malmö, with occasional travel to Älmhult as needed to meet business requirements. For any questions about the recruitment process, you can directly connect with vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.  

The contract title for this position is Data Engineer.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.title: Kundserviceagent med säljdriv!
jobs.description:
Gillar du att prata med människor, bygga relationer och samtidigt ha möjlighet att påverka din lön?

Är du serviceinriktad men har också ett starkt driv för försäljning? Trivs du med att arbeta mot mål och motiveras av provision? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig.

Vi söker nu en Junior Kundservicemedarbetare till ett växande team i Stockholm. Här kombinerar du kundservice med merförsäljning och arbetar med kunder som redan har en relation till företaget. Du hjälper kunderna i deras vardag samtidigt som du identifierar möjligheter att skapa ännu mer värde genom relevanta produkter och tjänster.

Det här är en perfekt roll för dig som gillar kundkontakt men också vill utvecklas inom försäljning.

Om rollen

Som Junior Kundservicemedarbetare arbetar du med befintliga kunder via telefon. Du svarar på frågor, följer upp ärenden och ser samtidigt möjligheter att utveckla kundrelationen genom rådgivning och merförsäljning.

Du blir en del av ett team där service och försäljning går hand i hand, och där ambition och engagemang uppmärksammas.

Arbetsuppgifter

    Kontakta befintliga kunder via telefon.
    Hantera frågor, supportärenden och kunduppföljningar.
    Identifiera kundernas behov och rekommendera relevanta tjänster och produkter.
    Arbeta aktivt med merförsäljning och uppgraderingar.
    Bygga långsiktiga relationer och skapa hög kundnöjdhet.
    Arbeta mot individuella försäljningsmål och följa upp dina resultat.
    Samarbeta med kollegor för att nå teamets gemensamma mål.

Vem är du?

Du tycker om att prata med människor och får energi av kundkontakt. Samtidigt gillar du känslan av att stänga affärer och ser möjligheten till provision som något motiverande.

Kanske arbetar du idag inom kundservice, butik, restaurang eller annan servicebransch och känner att du vill ta nästa steg. Kanske har du redan testat på försäljning och vill fortsätta utvecklas.

Vi tror att du:

    Är social, positiv och kommunikativ.
    Tycker om att bygga relationer med kunder.
    Har ett starkt driv och gillar att arbeta mot mål.
    Motiveras av provision och möjligheten att påverka din inkomst.
    Är serviceinriktad men samtidigt affärsmässig.
    Trivs i ett högt tempo där det händer mycket.
    Tar eget ansvar och bidrar med positiv energi till teamet.
    Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat.

Kvalifikationer

    Gymnasieutbildning.
    Erfarenhet från kundservice, serviceyrken eller försäljning är meriterande.
    God datorvana.
    Erfarenhet av telefonkontakt med kunder är ett plus men inget krav.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom både kundservice och försäljning i en miljö där prestation lönar sig.

    Fast lön med attraktiv provisionsmodell.
    Gedigen introduktion och utbildning.
    Löpande coachning och utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Moderna lokaler i centrala Stockholm.
    Säljtävlingar, aktiviteter och stark teamkänsla.
    Goda möjligheter att växa vidare inom försäljning och kundrelationer.

Övrigt

Ort: Stockholm
Omfattning: Heltid
Start: Enligt överenskommelse

Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Vid frågor varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Amir på amir@kraftsam.se

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Clinical AI Devices
jobs.description:
Job Summary

In the Clinical AI Devices team, the Software Engineer is primarily responsible for building and maintaining software in the Clinical AI domain, from wrapping deep learning models into containerized medical devices, to integration with other systems. This work spans all of the company's medical devices, across the main radiology modalities: X-Ray, CT, MRI, and Mammography. The focus of the current role is at the interface between product logic and the underlying serving platform, ensuring that requests are correctly validated, routed, and that results are properly assembled and returned.

 

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

  • Participate in the software development process: design, refine, and develop new features, and maintain existing ones.

  • Write code, review teammates' code, and contribute to the testing framework through automated and manual tests. Work with the team lead and product manager to refine requirements.

  • Own features and projects end-to-end, from refinement to production. Flag risks and bugs by keeping the radiologist's workflow in mind. Support service and delivery teams with production issues.

  • Ensure compliance with Quality and Regulatory requirements throughout the development cycle, including technical documentation (e.g. implementation specs), cybersecurity processes, and risk analysis.

  • Collaborate with the team on strategic recommendations and improvements to technology and business.

    PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in a related field such as computer science, biomedical engineering or similar (required).

  • Experience (required): at least 5 years of experience in a similar or related relevant role

  • At least 5 years of experience working with Java, with proficiency in Spring Boot (required).

  • Fluent in English (required).

  • Accustomed to CI/CD practice (required).

  • Familiar with test-driven development and testing frameworks like JUnit (required).

  • Experience working with docker, cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, and Kubernetes (required).

  • Experience working with Agentic Coding tools like Claude and Cursor (preferred).

  • Experience working with microservices and distributed systems (preferred).

  • Experience in the MedTech field, e.g. working with DICOM data, AI algorithms, and clinical workflows (preferred).

 

What we value

  • Strong analytical mindset.

  • Not afraid of working inside a strong regulatory framework and disciplined about testing needs.

  • Ability to make well-reasoned trade-offs between velocity and quality, understanding when to work for higher quality and when to optimize for time-to-market.

  • You collaborate openly, support your colleagues, and contribute to shared success. 

 

 Quality Standards

  • Communicate, cooperate, and consistently function professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrate initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercise confidentiality in all areas of performance. 

  • Follow all local, regional, and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follow all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follow data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practice universal safety precautions.

  • Promote good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapt and willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Report to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meals and rest breaks, and maintain satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Complete job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

 

Working Environment

Hybrid, remote-friendly

Based in France (we have offices in Paris and Grenoble) or in the Netherlands (we have offices in Rotterdam and Amsterdam)

  • Er serviceinnstilt  
  • Er strukturert og ryddig – du vet at utstyr ikke rydder seg selv 
  • Behersker norsk og engelsk – nok til å forklare hva et SUP‑brett er, og du bør være innstilt på å kommunisere andre språk gjennom digital oversetting. 
  • Kan jobbe kveld og kanskje en gang iblant på helg 

Andre opplysninger

Jevnaker kommune er opptatt av mangfold, og vi oppfordrer derfor alle som er kvalifisert til å søke hos oss uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, livssyn og nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Iflg. Offentlighetslovens §25 plikter arbeidsgiver å gjøre søkere oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet. Jevnaker kommune vil varsle søkere som har bedt om unntakelse fra offentlighet hvis dette ønsket ikke kan imøtekommes.   
Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jevnaker er en kommune i vekst og utvikling - strategisk plassert nær Hønefoss, Oslo og Gardermoen - geografisk plassert i sørenden av Randsfjorden og nært Nordmarka. Jevnaker er vertskommune for kunst– og kulturdestinasjonene Hadeland Glassverk og Kistefos-Museet, og har et rikt og aktivt kultur-, fritids- og idrettsliv. Kommunen har ca 7000 innbyggere, full barnehagedekning, et godt skoletilbud og gode helse- og omsorgstjenester. Kommunens overordnede visjon er Fjordlandsbyen Jevnaker – fra Rock til Rullator. Et av kommunens hovedmål er å utvikle Jevnaker til en klimaklok kommune. Våre verdier er: Åpen – Nytenkende – Redelig. Kommunens lederfilosofi er inkluderende, motiverende, ekte og veiledende ledelsesutøvelse. Medarbeidere og ledere i Jevnaker kommune utfordres og stilles krav til, men gis også tillit og aktiv støtte.

jobs.title: Jeg søker flere gode støttespillere til hverdagen min i Ørsta
jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA
📅 Tiltredelse: Snarest
📌 Stillingstype: Fast deltid og tilkalling
⏰ Arbeidstid: Dagtid i hverdager og noe helg

Hei!

Jeg er en rolig og trivelig mann som bor i Ørsta sammen med samboeren min. Nå ser jeg etter nye assistenter til BPA-teamet mitt – både en fast assistent og tilkallingsvikarer.

For meg er det aller viktigste at du er en trygg, omsorgsfull og tålmodig person som ser mennesket bak behovet for assistanse. Personlig kjemi betyr mye i denne jobben, og jeg ønsker å finne noen som jeg kan føle meg trygg sammen med, og som passer godt inn i hverdagen min.

Jeg har behov for hjelp til både praktiske oppgaver og personlig omsorg. Dagsformen min varierer, og jeg sliter også med fatigue, som gjør at energinivået kan være forskjellig fra dag til dag. Noen ganger har jeg behov for at det er stille og rolig rundt meg, og da er det fint om du kan ta deg av praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet eller bidra med tilrettelegging. Andre ganger har jeg overskudd til hyggelige samtaler eller små turer ut når formen tillater det. Derfor ser jeg etter en assistent som er rolig, fleksibel og flink til å lese situasjoner og tilpasse seg det jeg trenger der og da. Det viktigste er at du bidrar til en trygg og god hverdag, uansett hvordan dagen ser ut.

Jeg bruker stav innendørs og rullestol utendørs. Jeg liker å komme meg litt ut når formen tillater det, men det viktigste i denne stillingen er ikke aktivitetene i seg selv – det er at du er en person jeg fungerer godt sammen med.

Stillingen

Vi tilbyr i første omgang en fast stilling med to vakter i uken, seks timer per vakt. Det tilsvarer omtrent 12 timer per uke. På sikt vil det kunne være mulighet for en større fast stilling.

I tillegg søker vi tilkallingsvikarer som kan stille opp ved behov, for eksempel ved sykdom, ferieavvikling eller ekstra behov i perioder.

Arbeidstiden vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid i hverdager, vanligvis mellom kl. 08.00 og 14.00. Enkelte helgevakter kan forekomme.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Personlig stell og praktisk bistand i hverdagen

  • Husarbeid og rengjøring

  • Massasje og gjennombevegelse (Jeg sliter med dårlig blodsirkulasjon og derfor er dette en viktig del av hverdagen)

  • Matlaging og andre praktiske gjøremål

  • Følge til avtaler eller aktiviteter ved behov

  • Bidra til trygghet, ro og en god hverdag

Personlige egenskaper

  • Omsorgsfull og trygg

  • Flink til å lese situasjoner og tilpasse seg skiftende behov og dagsform

  • Rolig, tålmodig og fleksibel

  • God til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit

  • Selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst

  • Praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert

  • Personlig egnethet og kjemi vil bli tillagt stor vekt

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Førerkort klasse B og tilgang til bil

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før oppstart

  • Erfaring fra omsorgsarbeid er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Hvorfor velge denne jobben?

  • Du får en meningsfull jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell

  • Du blir en viktig og trygg person i hverdagen min

  • Du får mulighet til å bygge en nær og tillitsfull relasjon over tid

  • Du blir en del av et trygt arbeidsmiljø med tett oppfølging

  • Du får god opplæring og relevante kurs

Kvinner oppfordres spesielt til å søke.

Ved spørsmål om stillingen kan rekrutterer Petter Ariel Skog kontaktes på e-post: petter.skog@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,4 kroner, kveldstillegg på 67 kroner og helgetillegg på 70kroner

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer og nettbutikker

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Tett oppfølging fra BPA-koordinator

  • Verdifull erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Ansvarsfullt och givande arbete som assistent i Gävle
jobs.description:
Vi söker ny assistent för att komplettera en stabil grupp.

Det är viktigt att du har erfarenhet av autism och ser fördelen i att bygga en relation i syfte att kunna bli ett starkt stöd. Vidare kräver tjänsten empati för kundens situation och behov, men samtidigt mogenhet och styrka att upprätthålla ramar för kundens välbefinnande.

Kunden har en daglig verksamhet och tycker annars om att vistas i skog och mark eller att göra utflykter, så det krävs fysik att promenera långt och hänga med. Kan du cykla?

I övrigt förväntar vi oss erfarenhet av att sköta om ett hem i att planera inköp, städa och tvätta etc.

Det finns flera erfarna duktiga assistenter runt kunden som kan ge dig en trygg introduktion. Det är väldigt viktigt att kunna arbeta tillsammans med andra assistenter och förbereda och genomföra de olika momenten, ibland i par, samt att kunna dokumentera och rapportera.

Beskriv dig själv och dina erfarenheter i relation till annonsen. Berätta gärna lite om din egen sociala situation och dina intressen. Skicka med ett CV och märk din ansökan med "Gävle". Foto är trevligt :-)

Vi har kollektivavtal genom Fremia och vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag.

jobs.title: Säljare – för dig som gillar människor, resultat & högt tempo
jobs.description:
Kickstarta din karriär inom försäljning

Är du social, driven och gillar människor? Triggas du dessutom av affärer, tydliga mål och möjligheten att påverka vad du tjänar?

Då kan det här vara ett riktigt bra nästa steg.

Vi söker nu säljare till ett team där man gillar att prestera, göra affärer och ha kul tillsammans på jobbet. Här får du tidigt ta ansvar för kunddialoger, lära dig försäljning på riktigt och utveckla kunskaper som du kommer ha nytta av oavsett vart karriären tar dig.

Och du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett.

Du får en bra introduktion och börjar med varmare kundkontakter och mer lättillgängliga affärer, där du får möjlighet att hitta ditt sätt att kommunicera, testa olika säljtekniker och bygga självförtroende. I takt med att du blir tryggare får du successivt ta dig an fler typer av kunder och mer utmanande affärer.

Det ger dig en riktigt bra miljö att lära dig försäljning från grunden – utan att kastas rakt ut i den djupa änden.

Att börja sin arbetskarriär inom försäljning kan dessutom vara ett starkt avstamp framåt. Du lär dig att kommunicera med olika typer av människor, förstå behov, argumentera, förhandla, hantera motgångar och driva affärer hela vägen i mål – erfarenheter som är meriterande i många framtida roller.

Vad kommer du att göra?

Du arbetar aktivt med försäljning och kundkontakt och får lära dig hela processen, från första dialog till affär.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    Ha kontakt med kunder där det redan finns ett intresse eller en etablerad relation.
    Skapa förtroende och bygga relationer med olika typer av människor.
    Förstå kundens behov och hitta rätt lösning.
    Driva dialogen framåt och arbeta mot avslut.
    Börja med mer lättillgängliga kunddialoger och successivt utvecklas mot mer komplexa affärer.
    Arbeta mot tydliga mål och följa dina egna resultat.
    Utvecklas inom försäljning, kommunikation och affärsmannaskap.

Här är siffror och resultat en naturlig del av vardagen. Du vet hur du ligger till, vad du presterar och vad som krävs för att nå nästa nivå.

Vem är du?

Vi är mer intresserade av vem du är och vart du vill än av en perfekt titel på ditt CV.

Du kanske redan säljer idag. Du kanske jobbar i butik, kundservice, restaurang eller annan service och har märkt att du är riktigt bra på människor. Eller så är du i början av arbetslivet och vill hitta en roll där du snabbt kan utvecklas.

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – vi arbetar med löpande urval.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Amir Sten på amir@kraftsam.seeller 070-777 02 88.

jobs.title: Kundsupport
jobs.description:
Vill du göra karriär utomlands och samtidigt arbeta för ett välkänt och etablerat bolag? Trivs du i en internationell miljö där kundrelationer står i fokus? Härligt, då är det läge att läsa vidare!

I utkanten av Malaga, Fuengirola ligger vår prisbelönta kundservice som fått fina utmärkelser för vår goda service. Vi är ett snabbt växande bolag med höga ambitioner och mål. Idag är vi runt 300 medarbetare från åtta olika länder och på kontoret möts du av en energifull arbetsmiljö.

Hur ser din nya roll ut som kundservicemedarbetare för den svenska marknaden?

Hos oss är kunden i fokus! Ditt viktigaste uppdrag är att hjälpa våra kunder över telefon, chatt och mail med allt från fakturaärenden, tekniska frågor och bokning av service, till information om våra komponenter. Du lyssnar in vad kunden behöver hjälp med och erbjuder därefter den bästa tänkbara lösningen. Vi vill ha en långvarig positiv inverkan på våra kunders liv och vi är stolta över att kunna ge våra kunder en förstklassig service. I rollen samarbetar du med olika avdelningar, i ett högt tempo med flera ärenden i gång samtidigt. För att du ska få bästa möjliga start börjar du din karriär hos oss med en tre veckors gedigen introduktionsutbildning tillsammans med våra coacher. Utbildningen är givetvis betald.

Kundcentret har öppet på telefon måndag–fredag kl. 08.00–16.00. Chatten är öppen måndag–torsdag kl. 08.00–20.00 och fredag kl. 08.00–18.00. Du kommer att vara schemalagd 8 timmar per arbetspass.

Att flytta utomlands är spännande och lärorikt men kan också vara en stor förändring. För att göra flytten enklare, stöttar vi dig med att skaffa utländskt personnummer, socialförsäkring samt inskrivning på en spansk vårdcentral.

I vår matsal serveras, varje dag, gratis frukost och lunch till alla våra anställda. Vi erbjuder också friskvårdsbidrag och språkbidrag om du exempelvis vill läsa spanska. Utöver detta välkomnas du att delta i våra sociala evenemang och teamaktiviteter i soliga Spanien med cirka 300 soldagar årligen.

Vem söker vi efter?

Vi söker dig som har en positiv inställning och är duktig på att kommunicera. Du är flexibel och har lätt att anpassa dig till nya rutiner, situationer och arbetssätt. Vi ser att du är förbättringsvillig med viljan att alltid bli bättre på det du gör. Utöver detta ser vi att du har en god datavana och är van vid att hålla många bollar i luften samtidigt. Du behärskar både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift samt är prickfri i polisens belastningsregister. Det är starkt meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av kundtjänstsupport via telefon och mail.

Det gör skillnad att arbeta på Sector Alarm - vi skapar säkrare hem och satsar på din utveckling.

Sector Alarm är en trygg arbetsplats där vi sätter en ära i att jobba nära våra medarbetare. När du arbetar för oss lovar vi att arbeta för dig. Vi kommer att skapa förutsättningar för att du ska lära dig nya saker och utveckla det som du redan är bra på. Vi har i Sverige blivit utsedda till Årets karriärföretag för elfte (!) året i rad och därmed har du goda möjligheter till att ta vidare steg i karriären.

Vi arbetar för en inkluderande arbetskultur och tar hand om samt stöttar varandra. Vi är öppna, ärliga och firar framgångar gemensamt – stora som små. Vi lyckas tillsammans.

Det vi gör, det är på riktigt – bli en del av vår resa och skapa säkrare hem och tryggare liv över hela Europa.

Vill du utvecklas och skapa tryggare liv? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

I din ansökan vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV, svarar på urvalsfrågorna samt skriver en motivering till varför du är intresserad av tjänsten och att arbeta hos oss. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering på vårt kontor i Fuengirola, adressen är Calle Geranio 1, 29651, Fuengirola. En månads provanställning tillämpas.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att ta kontakt med Talent Acquisition Specialist, Anna Avela på anna.avela@sectoralarm.se

Är du nyfiken på hur det är att jobba hos oss, ta gärna en titt på vårt konto @sectoralarmcs på Instagram.

Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

jobs.title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (H/F), Paris
jobs.description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Paris).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.

jobs.title: PhD position in marine biology in the EU project “Remedies”
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Biology (IBI) at NV faculty has a vacant 3-year PhD position for a marine macroalgae research in the Marine Sciences section  The position is part of a NTNU well known niche nationally using enabling technology for research and education of algal (phytoplankton, ice algae, macroalgae) dynamics to provide knowledge needed for better ecosystem function and management. This position will be shared with researchers at Department of Biotechnology and Food Science (IBT) focusing on biochemistry (also at NV faculty at NTNU). In addition, the PhD will also collaborate with SINTEF Industry (Department of Biotechnology and Nanomedicine) focusing on industrial applications. 

The overarching aim of the Marine Sciences section is focused on sustainable management, production, and utilization of biological marine resources. The announced position will be important in utilizing the momentum in educating the next NTNU generation of marine scientists using enabling technologies to understand, monitor and improve ecosystem health including reduction of human induced stress in the environment. Our departments do work with industry to find solutions and enhance the understanding of ecosystem function to utilize resources in a benign manner to provide “good ecology = good economy”.

The PhD candidate will be part of the EU Horizon project “Restoring ocean and waters in waterfront cities and their ports”. The specific objectives are to 1) protect and restore marine and freshwater ecosystems and biodiversity, 2) prevent and eliminate pollution of our ocean, seas and waters and 3) make a blue economy sustainable, carbon neutral and circular.

In Trondheim, our major environmental challenge is sewage and industry wastewater discharge into the Trondheimsfjord, inducing multiple stressors for marine production and biodiversity. Cascade effects, including replacements of kelp species with filamentous algae (“turf”), loss of fish and poor water quality.

Remedies approach: Restore declining population and habitats, including cultivation of kelp to remove excessive nutrients, heavy metals and provide biomass for products in the new blue economy. Our goal is to contribute to reduced pollution, better restoration, maintenance of biodiversity and improved water quality.

The main activities for the PhD will be to contribute to ensure habitat functions in macroalgae along coastal areas near Trondheim (restoration) which also include cultivation of seaweed at sites with different degrees of pollution level (e.g. nutrient loads and heavy metals). Identification, mapping and monitoring macroalgal growth zones and key environmental variables such as light, temperature, salinity, nutrient loads (e.g. nitrate, phosphate, silicate) by using different robotic platforms (using the operation pyramid comprising mini satellites, aerial drones, autonomous surface and underwater vehicles and moorings) in collaboration with Applied Underwater Robotic laboratory (NTNU) and Fjordlab (part of Ocean Space Centre in Trondheim of (NTNU & SINTEF) will be carried out.

The seaweed elemental composition will be analyzed for using cultivated seaweed as bioindicators (uptake of nutrients and pollutants), and biorefinery, including product development, for selected applications will be part of the project.

The hired candidate will be able to join a dynamic, cross-disciplinary team that is working on the development of new techniques to provide ecological, physiological and biochemical information needed for enhanced environmental monitoring and corresponding industrial applications.

The primary workplace will be at the Trondheim Biological Station, but changes in the place of work may occur during the project period.

Your immediate leader will be the head of the department of Biology.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Provide time-series of Key Environmental Variables (KEV) in Trondheimsfjord and corresponding growth dynamics of selected macroalgal species comprising brown, red and green macroalgae
  • Model species for natural habitats and growth cultures will be the kelp species Saccharina latissima and Alaria esculenta and the brown wreck Fucus vesiculosus
  • Combine information on elemental composition and ecophysiology (eg. photosynthetic parameters and pigment composition) in model species to use the algae as bioindicators of water quality and habitat stress level
  • Chemical characterisation of seaweed biomass (cultivated, from restoration areas and from wild populations)
  • Development of sequential biorefinery on cultivated biomass (several end-products for increased valorisation)
  • Separation of heavy metal rich fractions from biomass 
  • Communicate with stakeholders along the entire cultivation seaweed value chain and stay updated on national/international regulations (monitoring, restoration)

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in marine biology, biochemistry or biotechnology for ecological or biochemical studies of marine micro- and/or macroalgae. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have hands on experience with methods for in in situ and laboratory methods/observations to measure phytoplankton/macroalgal biomass and health status with focus on one/several topics related to biodiversity, biochemical composition, primary production and function)
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works
  • Excellent written and oral English skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • A MSc with experience from cross disciplinary work using enabling technology for marine ecology
  • Experience in algal systematics, pigment and sugar chemistry, statistics methods, user/making codes in R or Python
  • Experience using of underwater mobile platforms (e.g. pilot experience using Remotely Operated Vehicles) is beneficial
  • Experience with seaweed hatcheries and cultivation
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian equivalent level A2

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are/have: 

  • Hands on and highly motivated to use your PhD project as a contribution for a better marine nature management locally and internationally (core of Remedies project)
  • Demonstrated teamwork skills with ability to work closely as part of collegial teams, and to contribute to a good and inclusive working environment
  • Excellent communication skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • Exciting and challenging tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • Opportunity to join the NTNU Observation Pyramid team that includes several departments and faculties, working locally, nationally and internationally
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

Candidates will be evaluated based on documented qualifications. We encourage qualified candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity, ability status, or cultural, ethnic, or religious background. We especially encourage upcoming early career academics and candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. To develop an inclusive and vibrant departmental culture, the Department of Biology maintains a standing committee focused on diversity, equality, and inclusivity.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Biology within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English. Please address all required and preferred selection criteria in your application. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter explaining your interest and fit for this position max 1 page
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Copy of Master's thesis, else an abstract of 1000 words. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Academic works that you consider to be most relevant and which you wish to be considered during assessment of your application (up to 5 items) 
  • A list of your previous works, with details on where they have been published 
  • Names and contact information for three relevant referees 


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Geir Johnsen, Professor in marine ecology at IBI  geir.johnsen@ntnu.no, or Finn L. Aachman, Professor in biopolymer interaction at IBT finn.l.aachmann@ntnu.no. If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Alexander Nilsen Skomakerstuen (HR at IBI, NTNU) alexander.skomakerstuen@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 25.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

jobs.title: Einherjar søker isviking!
jobs.description:
Er du klar for en variert, spennende og meningsfull deltidsjobb? Jeg er en aktiv mann på 30 år som ser etter min neste «viking» – en pålitelig, engasjert og god BPA-assistent som vil være med å holde hverdagen i full gang.

Jeg bor i Elverum sammen med samboeren min og vår firbente venn (hund). MS gir meg utfordringer med syn og balanse, så jeg bruker rullestol til daglig, selv om jeg går litt selv også. Likevel stopper ikke det meg fra å leve et aktivt liv: jeg spiller ishockey og håndball, brenner for politikk og er engasjert i foreningsliv.

Nå trenger jeg deg som kan være mine ekstra øyne, hender og støtte i forbindelse med ishockey-treninger på Hamar.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgavene vil kunne variere med hverdagen min, men det jeg søker nå er:

  • Kjøre bil.
  • Hjelpe med organisering og tilrettelegging i forbindelse med ishockey.
  • Praktisk bistand i min hverdag, både hjemme og utenfor hjemmet.
  • Assistanse til husdyrhold.
  • Bistand ved deltakelse på idrettsaktiviteter, møter og arrangementer.
  • Lese og fylle ut skjemaer.
  • Handle mat og tilberede mat.

Arbeidstid

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet på ca. 9 timer i uken/25%, primært fordelt på:

·       Onsdag ettermiddag

·       Søndag ettermiddag/kveld

Siden jeg har et aktivt liv, kan det også bli muligheter for ekstravakter ved arrangementer eller turer.

Oppstart så snart som mulig.

Hvem er du?

Du trenger ingen spesiell fagbakgrunn – personlig egnethet og god kjemi betyr alt.

Du må derimot ha førerkort klasse B og være over 25 år grunnet forsikringer.

Jeg tror du vil trives godt om du:

  • Liker ishockey og idrett
  • Er praktisk anlagt, selvgående og initiativrik.
  • Er glad i hunder og glad i å være i aktivitet.
  • Har god humor, står støtt i hverdagen og er pålitelig.
  • Sterk i kroppen – for å kunne bistå meg i forflytning.
  • Fleksibel

Hva tilbyr jeg?

  • En uformell, trivelig og fartsfylt arbeidsplass.
  • Varierte arbeidsdager der ingen uke er helt lik.
  • Ordnet arbeidsforhold, opplæring og lønn etter gjeldende avtaler.
  • Egen kontakperson i Prima Assistanse
  • Kurs gjennom Prima Assistanse
  • Lønn og andre vilkår ihht Landsoverenskomsten for BPA

Jeg er arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse vil være arbeidsgiver.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send en kort søknad og CV der du forteller litt om deg selv, så tar vi en kaffeprat! Kun aktuelle kandidater blir kalt inn til intervju.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA

📌 Stillingstype: Fast og tilkalling

Vi er en aktiv familie på fire som bor på Gjelleråsen i Nittedal, rett ved Oslo-grensen. Vi søker nå flere trygge og engasjerte assistenter til vår datter på 5 år. Hun er et blidt, sosialt og nysgjerrig barn som elsker å være ute, leke, hoppe på trampoline, bade og utforske verden rundt seg. Hun trives når det skjer noe, enten det er en tur i butikken, en kjøretur eller lek hjemme, men hun trenger også trygge voksenpersoner som er rolige, tilstedeværende og opptatt av å skape trygghet og gode rammer.

Hun har en omfattende og varig funksjonsnedsettelse og epilepsi. Hun har sammensatte bistandsbehov knyttet til kognitive og motoriske utfordringer, samt manglende fareforståelse, og trenger kontinuerlig tilsyn. Hun er non‑verbal, men har god språkforståelse og kommuniserer gjennom kroppsspråk, mimikk, tegn‑til‑tale og ASK. Hun er en glad og aktiv jente, men hun har omfattende og sammensatte utfordringer. Derfor trenger hun ikke bare en lekekamerat, men en trygg, tålmodig og ansvarsfull voksen som kan gi tett støtte og oppfølging gjennom hele dagen.

For å sikre medvirkning og deltakelse trenger hun assistenter som vil lære hennes kommunikasjonsformer og støtte henne i hverdagen. Hun benytter seg av noen hjelpemidler, og kan gå med støtte. Livserfaring, omsorgsevne og et ønske om å gjøre en positiv forskjell i et barns hverdag vektlegges høyt.

⭐Arbeidstid:

Vi søker etter faste assistenter og tilkallingsvikarer som kan jobbe ettermiddager og helger, samt ved behov i ferier. Spesifiser gjerne i søknaden hvor mange ettermiddager i uken du kan jobbe. Stillingen innebærer også at man jobber fast hver tredje helg.

Ettermiddag: 16.00-20.00

Helger: 11.00-20.00

⭐Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Personlig stell, hygiene og på‑/avkledning

  • Forflytning og støtte i daglige aktiviteter

  • Tilrettelegging ved måltider og matlaging

  • Lek, aktivitet og deltakelse i familie- og hverdagsliv

  • Tett oppfølging og tilsyn inne og ute

  • Bidra til trygghet, mestring og gode opplevelser

  • Følge rutiner knyttet til epilepsi og helse

⭐Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Erfaring med barn er en fordel

  • Erfaring med funksjonsnedsettelser er positivt, men ikke et krav

  • Interesse for kommunikasjon, ASK eller tegn‑til‑tale

  • Må kunne svømme og trives i vann

  • Førerkort klasse B (automat)

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig

⭐Personlige egenskaper:

  • Trygg, omsorgsfull og tålmodig

  • Oppmerksom og observant

  • Aktiv, leken og initiativrik

  • Pålitelig, fleksibel og ansvarsbevisst

  • Evne til å skape gode relasjoner

  • Rolig og handlekraftig i ulike situasjoner

Vi håper å finne personer som ønsker å bidra til at datteren vår får en trygg, aktiv og meningsfull hverdag med mulighet til å delta i lek, familieaktiviteter og utvikling på lik linje med andre barn.

Hvis dette høres ut som noe for deg, håper vi du sender inn en søknad. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg! 💕

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karoline Clausen-Bekken på epost karoline.clausen-bekken@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Junior Brand Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

Job Description

Are you energised by bringing people, plans and ideas together to help turn brand strategy into concrete activation?  

We are looking for a Junior Brand Project Manager to join Vattenfall’s Group Brand Activation team. This is a dynamic role where you get to work with everything from coordination and planning to stakeholder management and campaign execution in an international, friendly and growth-oriented environment.  

About the role

As Junior Brand Project Manager, you will enable the planning and delivery of brand and communication activities that strengthen the Vattenfall brand and ensure high-quality execution across markets. You will support in several brand and marketing communication initiatives while simultaneously having ownership of your own projects

You will work closely with colleagues in the Group Brand team, other Communication teams and business areas, as well as external agencies. We work internationally across the Swedish, Finnish, Dutch and German markets.  

What you will do:

    Project & campaign coordination: Help manage timelines, deliverables, budgets and project plans. Coordinate meetings and communication across teams and partners to bring alignment between strategy, creative development and execution.  
    Agency collaboration: Coordination and contact with external agencies – making sure briefs, feedback and approvals are clear and well-structured.  
    Activation and implementation: Support delivery of brand activations across channels and markets, ensuring brand guidelines are applied consistently and securing a smooth rollout of campaigns and initiatives
    Tracking of results & insights: Gathering insights and track results of projects and initiatives, translating outcomes into clear summaries and recommendations. Tracking project progress and creating concise material for decision making and monitoring by executive management.  

Qualifications

You don't need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you're curious, eager to learn and find solutions even when the path forward is unpredictable. You enjoy working in a role where you need to reach out to people and you build trusting relationships thanks to your supportive attitude and ability to communicate in a clear and engaging way. You have a knack for creating structure and keeping both details and the bigger picture in mind.  

We believe you bring 1-3 years of experience in marketing, project coordination, communication or agency environment where you've obtained:

    Understanding of brand building and insight-driven marketing communication
    Experience of campaign work: the process for executing marketing campaigns from planning to delivery
    Experience of leading or coordinating projects
    Good MS Office skills
    Basic knowledge and experience using AI tools to support project coordination, content development, planning, and everyday ways of working along with a curiosity about best-practice developments within AI and digital tools.

Additionally, you have a university degree in Marketing, Business, Communication or related field as necessary along with fluency in English and basic Swedish skills.  

It's an advantage if you also have:  

    Knowledge of German and/or Dutch as we work across several markets.  
    Experience working across teams and with creative agencies in international or multi-market environments.

Additional Information

Our Offer

As a Junior Brand Project Manager you will be a brand ambassador from day one. With the Brand function as your foundation, you will collaborate and support colleagues across different markets and business areas – enabling you to learn and grow in several ways. We have recently set a new direction for our brand and are working on several initiatives and projects for continued future brand growth, which you will have a key role in realizing with us.

Location: Solna, Stockholm

For more information about the recruitment process, contact the recruiter Louise Doverholt at louise.doverholt@vattenfall.com.

Trade union representatives are Anders Bohlin (Unionen), Robert Lönnqvist (SEKO), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna) and Marika Westman (Akademikerna). To get in contact with the representatives, call Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.

We welcome your application in English no later than 22nd of October. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.



At Vattenfall, we value being active, positive, open, and safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our corporate culture. We firmly believe that diversity helps build a more profitable and attractive company, and we strive to be good role models when it comes to diversity. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall.

Working at Vattenfall means working with critical societal infrastructure. Therefore, many of our positions are security-classified, and you may be required to fill a wartime posting. If this position is security-classified, a security clearance will be carried out before employment, in accordance with the Security Protection Act. Any potential wartime posting will be based on the employment contract and the Total Defence Service Act.

We look forward to receiving your application!

    Personlige egenskaper

    • Du har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner.
    • Du arbeider selvstendig og strukturert.
    • Du er fleksibel og løsningsorientert.
    • Du møter brukere med respekt, omsorg og godt humør.
    • Du bidrar til et positivt arbeidsmiljø.

    Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

    Vi tilbyr

    Hos oss får du blant annet:

    • Meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver i et godt arbeidsmiljø.
    • Opplæring og veiledning
    • lønn etter gjeldende avtaler og regelverk
    • gode pensjonsordninger gjennom KLP
    • en arbeidsplass som er IA‑bedrift
    • mulighet for barnehageplass
    • hjelp til å skaffe bolig, hvis du trenger det
    • en arbeidshverdag der du møter mennesker i deres eget hjem og får oppleve meningsfulle møter som gir både deg og andre gode opplevelser.

     

    Søknad sendes:

    Lavangen kommune benytter elektronisk rekrutteringssystem, og vi ber deg derfor fylle ut elektronisk og kun søknader mottatt via vårt system vil bli vurdert.   
    (Dersom du ikke søker direkte via Lavangen kommunes hjemmeside, må du gå inn på www.lavangen.kommune.no, og søke via linken "ledig stilling".  Deretter finner du riktig stilling og "søk på stilling").  Attesterte attester og vitnemål må bringes til eventuelt intervju.  
     
    I henhold til offentlighetsloven kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om å ikke bli oppført på søkerliste. Hvis det etter kommunens vurderinger ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn til unntak, vil søkerlisten bli offentliggjort.  Søker vil i et slikt tilfelle bli kontaktet på forhånd. 

    KontaktinformasjonNan Tove Thomassen, Avdelingssykepleier, 922 38 884, nan.tove.thomassen@lavangen.kommune.no
    Norunn Johansen, helse- og omsorgsleder., +47 911 90 878
    ArbeidsstedNesveien 32
    9357 TENNEVOLL
    Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Lavangen kommune

    Referansenr.: 5187944769
    Stillingsprosent: 50%
    Fast
    Søknadsfrist: 20.10.2026

    Om arbeidsgiveren:

    Lavangen kommune ligger i Indre Sør-Troms, og har ca.1000 innbyggere innenfor et område på 5 mil fra ytterpunktene. I kjøretid ligger Lavangen kommune ca. 1 time fra Narvik, ca. 2 timer fra Harstad og ca. 3 timer fra Tromsø.  Til de nærmeste flyplassene Bardufoss og Evenes er de ca. 1 times kjøring. Kommunen og omegn har mange turmuligheter både til fjells, langs elver og på fjorden. Det er et godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og ungdom med barne- og ungdomsskole og full barnehagedekning.

    Pleie, rehabilitering, omsorgstjenester er samordnet for institusjon og hjemmetjenester som også ser nødvendigheten av tverrfaglig samarbeid.  Vi kan tilby et godt arbeidsmiljø samt rekruttering og stimuleringstiltak for sykepleiere. I tråd med kommunens samiske helseplan etterspørres søkere med samisk språk- og kulturbakgrunn til stillinger i PRO-avd.
