jobs.title: Benefits Manager
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Our benefits offering has room to grow, and we want someone to own it end to end. You'll take our benefits from where they are today to something our people genuinely value and that helps us compete for brilliant talent, without turning it into a bureaucratic maze.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You'll be the person who makes benefits actually work day to day, across all the countries where we employ people.

 

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • Partner with in country People Ops to help manage our benefits programmes day to day across our employing countries, including pensions, insurances, health and wellbeing, leave and any local perks.

  • Manage brokers, providers and renewals. Push for better value and a better experience for our people, and keep a close eye on cost.

  • Track legislation changes & keep our benefits compliant in every country we operate in, and flag anything that needs a decision early.

  • Help managers understand what we offer and why, so they can talk to their teams with confidence.

  • Use data to spot what people actually use and value, and bring ideas for what we should add, change or drop.

  • Take the lead on the day-to-day of our global benefits review: gather the data on what we offer in each country, benchmark it against the market, and help shape the recommendations that come out of it.

  • Support benefits as we grow into new markets, and help scope new benefits from idea to launch.

  • Keep our benefits records, systems and vendor data clean, accurate and secure.

  • Partner with the local People Ops team to manage our benefits platforms and push it to be genuinely good: self-serve, quick to use, and clear enough that people can sort their own benefits in a few clicks without asking anyone.

 

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • 5 - 8 years experience running employee benefits, ideally across more than one country.

  • A good grasp of how benefits work in practice: pensions, risk and health cover, and the tax and compliance basics that sit behind them.

  • Comfort managing vendors and renewals, and a track record of getting good value.

  • Strong organisation. You keep lots of moving parts on track without dropping things.

  • Confidence with data and spreadsheets, and good judgement about what the numbers mean.

  • A self-starter mindset. You're happy owning your area without a big team around you.

  • Build the business case for what we invest in benefits, and show the return: what it costs, what people actually use and value, and what it does for retention and hiring.

  • Bring the numbers and the story together so leadership can make confident calls on benefits spend, and so we can explain to our people why we've invested where we have.

  • Track how our benefits are landing, be honest about what isn't working, and make the case to shift the money to what does.

 

⭐️ Bonus points:

  • Experience in a fast-growing tech or software business.

  • Exposure to benefits globally.

  • Understanding of different country payroll and tax processes

  • Familiarity with HRIS and benefits platforms.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
💰 £50,000 to £60,000 depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Two days a week in the office, the rest remote.

 

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Business Operations keeps money moving correctly, keeps the platform safe, and keeps us on the right side of our banking, payment and regulatory relationships. It covers payments and payout infrastructure, treasury, verification and KYC, fraud and risk, Trust and Safety, compliance, and the data work underneath all of it. Most of that surface is currently held by a small number of very senior people. This role exists to work alongside them across all of it.

 

🎯 The Role

 

We're hiring an Operations Manager to sit at the centre of Business Operations, reporting to our Chief Business Operations Officer and working closely with our Senior Operations Manager.

This is deliberately a broad role, and we want to be straight about what that means. You will not have one fixed remit. You will be pointed at whatever the most important operational problem is that week, and expected to pick it up, work out what is actually going on, and drive it to a conclusion. Some weeks that is building out system flows. Some weeks it is a number that does not reconcile, a live incident, or a compliance pack that has to be right by end of day.

You will be taught directly by the CBOO, not handed a wiki. You will have data warehouse and provider system access from your first week. Success in month one is not output, it is that you understand how money moves through the business and have started closing things out without being chased.

You will start broad and stay broad for a while. Over time we will shape your work towards whichever areas suit you, with the intent that you eventually own one properly, with a remit and in time a team.

 

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Take on whatever is most urgent: ambiguous, half-understood problems that need the facts established and the loop closed

  • Run the operational side of our payment, payout, verification and risk provider relationships, from stuck tickets to due diligence packs

  • Reconcile what our providers say happened against what our systems say happened, and chase down every difference until it is explained

  • Investigate risk and fraud alongside the fraud team, and propose the controls that close the gaps

  • Support live incidents involving money or user safety, running the analysis and owning the follow-up

  • Write it all down: runbooks, process docs, control documentation, post-incident reviews

 
 

👀 Who You Are

  • Someone who moves on their own initiative. When you hit a wall, your instinct is to find the way round it rather than report it

  • Someone who finishes things reliably, without being chased, including the boring parts

  • Comfortable with numbers. You can pull data, check it against a second source, and notice when something does not add up

  • A clear writer. Muddled writing usually means muddled thinking

  • Intellectually honest. You separate what you have verified from what you are assuming, and say when you do not know

  • Someone who gets more careful under pressure, not less

  • Someone who wants direct, frequent feedback

  • Roughly 1 to 3 years in anything that demanded accuracy and independent thinking: operations, finance, consulting, analytics, support, or a startup where you did a bit of everything

  • Fintech or payments operations exposure is a strong plus. You do not need payments, KYC or compliance experience, management experience despite the title, or SQL on day one

  • Unconventional career paths welcome, if you can explain why yours prepared you for this

 
 

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

  • You want unusual range and exposure early in your career

  • You get more organised when things get busy

  • You would rather be trusted with something difficult than given something safe

  • You like closing loops and seeing problems actually end

 
 

⚠️ You'll Struggle Here If

  • You want a clearly bounded remit and a predictable week

  • You need to be told what to work on next

  • You are comfortable leaving loose ends for someone else

  • You want the title to come with a team on day one

 
 

🌍 Why Join Fanvue?

  • Sunday Times Best Places to Work, two years running. We don't just say we have great culture, we prove it

  • Fanvue supports hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans globally. The problems you solve here are real and immediate

  • Direct coaching from our Chief Business Operations Officer, which is unusual at this level

  • AI-native: we are not bolting AI on. It is core to our product and how we work

  • Series A momentum: triple-digit growth means the problems you solve today define the platform for years

  • Two days a week in the London office, the rest wherever you work best, with WeWork access when you want it

  • High annual leave flexibility and flexible working hours

  • Salary reviews every six months, we don't wait for annual cycles to recognise your growth

  • Support with upskilling and development costs

  • Travel and office budgets for team off-sites or kitting out your home setup

  • Benefits package including gym memberships, apps, and more we're actively building out

 
 

⭐ Fanvue is for Everyone

We know that diverse teams build better products. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Potential, mindset, and ambition matter just as much as experience.

Following our recent £15M series B funding, regulatory milestones hit, and doubling from 50 to 100 headcount in 2025, we're ready to scale further internationally, making history for AI in healthcare and the future of dermatology.

We're proud to epitomise AI for good - with a Class III CE mark, DERM is the only AI as a medical device approved to make clinical decisions autonomously in the cancer space, as well as being the first company to receive a NICE recommendation for use across the NHS.*

DERM is deployed at more than 28 NHS organisations where we enable patients to gain significantly quicker access to skin cancer diagnosis. If that's not enough, we also collaborate with some of the largest health insurers to reach patients in their own homes.

We are a team of passionate people on a mission to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer.

Brief overview
This role owns the messaging architecture that underpins everything the marketing function produces. Builds and maintains the positioning and messaging platform that makes the company's strategic transition commercially effective across multiple products, markets, and audiences. Operating in close partnership with Product and commercial leadership, the output will directly impact how products are understood and adopted at a system and national level.

Responsibilities

Messaging and Positioning

  • Builds and maintains the core messaging framework across DERM audience platforms. Defines positioning, value proposition, proof points, and claims by product, audience and market

  • NHS strategic narrative: Develop the positioning for product transitions, and future lifecycle stages, articulating a clinically credible and scalable adoption pathway. Defines how Skin Analytics differentiates from competitors and makes the case for systemic adoption in primary and secondary care.

  • Defines the strategic positioning and competitive differentiation for international expansion in partnership with commercial leadership. Sets the foundation the PMM executes against.

  • Define and build Market entry positioning for priority International markets, accounting for differences in healthcare system structure, clinical procurement culture, and regulatory context in each geography

Claims Governance

  • Build and maintain the claims library in conjunction with Medical Director / Research teams. Define the process and governance for adding, updating, and retiring claims, ensuring the team can produce compliant content at speedy sign-off.

  • Works with Clinical and Innovation teams to understand forthcoming clinical evidence and ensures marketing positioning is built to leverage it.

Sales Enablement

  • Develops the Sales Enablement Framework for commercial teams: battle cards, pitch decks, case study briefs, objection handling, and market-specific materials.

  • Ensures the PMM delivers the sales enablement content, and it is built, stored, and tracked so commercial teams have a single, current resource base and adoption can be actively measured.

  • Run structured win/loss analysis and translate findings into updated messaging, positioning, and enablement materials with clear commercial accountability for outcomes

Go-to-Market

  • Owns the go-to-market process for new products (launch playbooks) and product updates.

  • Briefs the Marketing Manager on digital content requirements based on messaging framework, ensuring campaign execution is consistent across all channels

Accountable for

  • Win rate and sales cycle length, improvement attributed to sales enablement quality

  • Claims library completeness and adoption rate by team

  • Launch readiness, integrated with product team to ensure products launched with complete messaging and enablement on time

  • Commercial team satisfaction with PMM output, measured through regular and structured feedback

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated track record developing and owning positioning and messaging frameworks for complex B2B products in a multi-market, multi-audience environment. Healthcare, medtech, or clinical SaaS experience is strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to design and synthesise market, customer, and competitive intelligence into positioning that differentiates the product. Previous evidence that intelligence directly shaped positioning decisions and commercial differentiation.

  • Experience running structured win/loss analysis and ability to translate findings into updated messaging and sales enablement with measurable commercial impact.

  • Experience working between product, commercial, and marketing teams to translate product capability into commercially compelling narratives.

  • End to end GTM ownership across the full launch lifecycle: strategy, goal setting, cross functional alignment, execution, measurement, and post-launch review.

  • Evidence of managing conflicting priorities and tensions across different functions and products.

  • Proficient with HubSpot reporting and attribution tools to measure the commercial impact of PMM output: win rates, deal velocity, and enablement adoption rates. (or equivalent experience on Salesforce)

  • AI Literacy Actively uses AI tools as part of day-to-day workflow: competitive intelligence synthesis, market research, positioning iteration, and sales enablement development.

  • Comfortable with prompt engineering for efficient content and research tasks; able to produce high-quality, on-brand materials at pace using AI tooling.

jobs.title: Sykepleiekonsulent til nytt Fag- og mottaksteam i Bydel Stovner
jobs.employer: OSLO KOMMUNE BYDEL 11 STOVNER AVDELING HELSE AKTIVITET OG MESTRIN
jobs.description:
Vil du være med og videreutvikle fremtidens helse- og omsorgstjenester i Bydel Stovner? Vi søker en engasjert og faglig trygg sykepleiekonsulent som ønsker en sentral rolle i etableringen og utviklingen av vårt nye Fag- og mottaksteam.

Seksjon Vurdering og mestring er en del av Avdeling helse, aktivitet og mestring. Vi er i utvikling og har store ambisjoner for hvordan vi skal møte innbyggernes behov på en helhetlig, faglig og bærekraftig måte. I tråd med Oslo kommunes mål og føringer har vi gjennomført en utviklingsprosess i seksjonen, med særlig fokus på gode brukerforløp, tydeligere faglig ansvar, tverrfaglig samarbeid og riktig tjeneste til riktig tid.

Som en del av denne utviklingen etablerer vi et nytt Fag- og mottaksteam. Teamet får en sentral rolle i koordinering og oppfølging av innbyggere med behov for kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester, og skal bidra til helhetlige og sammenhengende brukerforløp mellom sykehus, helsehus, hjem og kommunale tjenester.

Fag- og mottaksteamet vil ha ansvarsområder knyttet til blant annet mottak og vurdering av nye henvendelser, saksbehandling, koordinering av brukerforløp, demens, velferdsteknologi og oppfølging i overganger mellom ulike tjenestenivåer. Teamet skal samarbeide tett med hjemmetjenesten, psykisk helse, fysio- og ergoterapitjenesten og øvrige interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere.

Som sykepleiekonsulent i Fag- og mottaksteamet får du en sentral og selvstendig rolle med ansvar for faglige vurderinger, kartlegging og koordinering av tjenester. Du skal innhente og vurdere nødvendige opplysninger, koordinere brukerforløp, initiere tverrfaglig samarbeid og fatte vedtak innenfor delegert myndighet. Arbeidet utføres i tråd med gjeldende lovverk, kommunale føringer og seksjonens mandat.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar, evner å gjøre selvstendige faglige vurderinger og tar gode beslutninger i komplekse situasjoner. Du har blikk for helheten og forstår at de beste løsningene skapes i samarbeid med brukere, pårørende og tjenestene rundt.

Hos oss får du mulighet til å være med på å forme og videreutvikle et fagområde i endring, og bidra til at innbyggerne i Bydel Stovner får forsvarlige, koordinerte og bærekraftige tjenester med utgangspunkt i egne ressurser, mål og behov.

Dette er stillingen for deg som ønsker å kombinere sykepleiefaglig kompetanse med koordinering, myndighetsutøvelse og utviklingsarbeid. Sammen med dyktige kolleger får du mulighet til å påvirke hvordan fremtidens tjenester skal utvikles og leveres til innbyggerne i Bydel Stovner.

Gyldig politiattest i henhold til helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4 må fremlegges ved tiltredelse.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gjennomføre faglige vurderinger, kartlegginger og oppfølging av innbyggere med behov for helse- og omsorgstjenester.
  • Behandle henvendelser, innhente nødvendige opplysninger og dokumentere vurderinger i aktuelle fagsystemer.
  • Fatte vedtak innenfor delegert myndighet i tråd med gjeldende lovverk og kommunale føringer.
  • Koordinere og følge opp helhetlige brukerforløp på tvers av tjenestenivåer.
  • Planlegge og bidra til trygge overganger mellom sykehus, helsehus, hjem og kommunale tjenester.
  • Delta i oppstartsamtaler, samarbeidsmøter og annet tverrfaglig arbeid med brukere, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Veilede brukere, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere om kommunens tjenestetilbud.
  • Bidra til god samhandling med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere.
  • Sikre brukermedvirkning og bidra til at brukerens mål, ressurser og ønsker legges til grunn for vurderinger og tjenestetilbud.
  • Delta i kvalitets-, forbedrings- og utviklingsarbeid, samt bidra til kompetansedeling og kunnskapsbasert praksis.
  • Behandle PLO-meldinger, vurdere behov for tjenester og fatte vedtak om blant annet korttidsopphold, samt søke inn aktuelle brukere til Forsterket Rehabilitering Aker (FRA).
  • Melde, følge opp og bidra til læring av avvik innen eget ansvarsområde. 
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som sykepleier.
  • Relevant erfaring fra kommunehelsetjenesten og/eller spesialisthelsetjenesten.
  • Erfaring med kartlegging og faglige vurderinger av brukeres funksjon, ressurser og behov for helse- og omsorgstjenester.
  • God forståelse for pasientforløp og samhandling mellom sykehus, helsehus og kommunale tjenester.
  • Erfaring med saksbehandling, tjenestetildeling og vedtaksarbeid innen kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester er ønskelig.
  • God kjennskap til relevant lovverk, samt krav til dokumentasjon og forsvarlig saksbehandling.
  • Evne til å innhente, analysere og sammenstille helseopplysninger som grunnlag for faglige vurderinger og beslutninger.
  • Erfaring med elektronisk meldingsutveksling (PLO-meldinger) og relevante fagsystemer er en fordel.
  • God digital kompetanse.
  • Meget gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.
  • Relevant videreutdanning innen eksempelvis geriatri, rehabilitering, helse- og omsorgsrett eller annet relevant fagområde er en fordel.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du har gode faglige vurderingsevner og evne til å se brukerens helhetlige behov, ressurser og muligheter gjennom hele brukerforløpet.
  • Du møter brukere og pårørende med respekt, trygghet og profesjonalitet, og er opptatt av reell brukermedvirkning.
  • Du arbeider selvstendig, strukturert og målrettet, og tar ansvar for egne vurderinger og beslutninger.
  • Du har god prioriterings- og beslutningsevne og evner å håndtere komplekse problemstillinger i en hektisk arbeidshverdag.
  • Du er løsningsorientert, fleksibel og håndterer endringer og uforutsette situasjoner på en profesjonell måte.
  • Du har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner og bidrar aktivt til tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • Du er utviklingsorientert, deler kunnskap og bidrar til fag-, kvalitets- og forbedringsarbeid.
  • Du har høy grad av ansvarsbevissthet og gjennomføringsevne.

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende og meningsfull stilling med mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av fremtidens helse- og omsorgstjenester i Bydel Stovner
  • Mulighet til å være med på å etablere og videreutvikle et nytt Fag- og mottaksteam
  • Et tverrfaglig, aktivt og engasjerende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og støttende kolleger
  • Faglige utfordringer og gode muligheter for kompetanseutvikling
  • Stor grad av selvstendighet og mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag
  • 37,5 timers arbeidsuke
  • Lønnstrinn 45
  • Rabatterte priser ved trening på SATS treningssenter
  • Gode låne,- tjenestepensjons- og forsikringsordninger i Oslo pensjonsforsikring. Som ansatt i Oslo kommune betaler arbeidsgiver i tillegg hele pensjonspremien din etter nettolønnsordningen, dvs. at det ikke trekkes 2 % av din brutto lønn til pensjonsinnskudd

Bydel Stovner ligger nordøst i Oslo med grense til Romeriksregionen. Her er gode kommunikasjonsmuligheter med tog, T– bane og buss. Bydel Stovner er en IA virksomhet og er en arbeidsplass preget av mangfold og inkludering.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us 

IVC Evidensia is the UK and Europe’s leading veterinary care group, made up of over 900 practices and referral hospitals, united by a shared purpose of happier animals, happier owners. 

At IVC Evidensia, we believe careers should be built without limits. Our people are supported to make more impact, access more career opportunities, and play an active role in their local and professional communities. Through investment in learning, innovation, and wellbeing, we create environments where our teams can grow in confidence, capability, and fulfilment—at every stage of their career. 

As part of Central Functions, you will be part of the teams that support and enable our network of over 2,500 practices across 20 countries, driving operational excellence, innovation, and strategic impact across the business.  

Our Technology teams are responsible for the systems and infrastructure that make that work - everything our healthcare professionals need to deliver world-class care. From keeping on top of patient records, health plans, client communications, diary management and dispensing, our teams have a lot to think about and need smarter ways to provide the convenience and expertise that modern Pet owners have come to expect.

IVC Evidensia is undergoing an exciting digital transformation. The key to this is improving the management of our core data sets - accelerating the standardisation of operational systems in practices, building stronger master data management tooling, and developing standard reporting models across the group.

As a data engineer, you will work with the team to advance the data platform within a DevOps culture. You will play a central role in building and maintaining scalable data pipelines across Databricks & Azure SQL Server, and will bring solid experience with ELT, orchestration, and scripting languages. A firm grasp of data modelling and management will be essential throughout.

The role

The Data Engineer will be a technical authority accountable for the design and development of the technologies that underpin our data strategy. At the heart of this is our Databricks data platform, and you will take ownership of building, optimising, and maintaining data pipelines using PySpark - orchestrating feeds from source systems through to our group data platform and taking technical ownership of all parts of the process.

You will work closely with the business to deliver solutions that address real challenges, engaging with SMEs to break requirements into deliverables. You will also collaborate with the Data Architect to shape our overarching data management strategy.

What you'll bring to the role

We're looking for a technically skilled and business aware individual with a strong understanding of data concepts, including storage, processing, and modelling. Core requirements include:

  • Databricks - hands-on experience building and managing workloads on the Databricks platform, including Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and Declarative Automation Bundles
  • PySpark - proficiency in writing and optimising PySpark code for data transformation and processing
  • Azure - solid experience working within the Azure ecosystem, including services such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure DevOps
  • Azure SQL Server - experience with Azure SQL Server is important, as it forms the foundation of our existing data warehouse. You will be working across both our SQL Server environment and our Databricks platform, and an understanding of how the two integrate will be key to success in this role
  • ELT & pipeline development - experience designing and maintaining pipelines using REST APIs, JSON, and ELT protocols
  • Data modelling - comfort working with both relational and non-relational data technologies, with a solid grounding in modelling principles

Exposure to business intelligence tools like Power BI is desirable. You'll act as a key interface between IT and functions such as Finance and Marketing, so excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills are vital.

You should be confident working within an Agile framework, with an understanding of secure development practices and non-functional requirements such as scalability, performance, and access management. An international mindset, sensitivity to local business priorities, and a collaborative approach are essential.

What’s in it for you? 
At IVC Evidensia, we’re committed to supporting your development and wellbeing.

When you join us, you’ll benefit from: 
A role with real business impact supporting teams across the organisation 
Clear career pathways with progression opportunities within Central Functions and beyond

jobs.title: Helgestillinger
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å bli vår nye kollega?

Saupstad hjemmetjeneste har ledig fire faste helgestillinger i 13 til 20 prosent stilling.

Helgestillingen vil innebære en fast turnus med gjennomsnittlig arbeid hver andre eller hver tredje helg.

Vi ønsker i tillegg at du er fleksibel og har mulighet til å jobbe som tilkallingsvikar. Som fast ansatt i helgestilling vil du også få tilbud om å jobbe i ferie og høytider.

Vi søker helsefagarbeidere og studenter innen helsefag. Vi oppfordrer også andre med erfaring innen helsetjenesten om å søke.

Ved Saupstad hjemmetjeneste yter vi tjenester til personer med ulike hjelpebehov. Dine kolleger ved enheten vil være helsefagarbeidere, sykepleiere, vernepleiere, ergoterapeuter, studenter innen helsefag og studenter innen andre fagområder.

Vi er opptatt av å inkludere nye kolleger, og vi har fokus på opplæring, veiledning, samarbeid og mestring.

Vår hovedoppgave er å yte gode tjenester slik at tjenestemottakerne får brukt sine egne ressurser og tilrettelegge for at de kan bo lengst mulig i eget hjem. God kommunikasjon med tjenestemottakerne og pårørende er viktig for å lykkes i dette arbeidet.

Vi har kontorer på Flatåsen i romslige og funksjonelle lokaler. Hit er det gode bussforbindelser og i tillegg har vi mulighet for parkering.

Mer informasjon om jobb i helse i Trondheim kommune finnes på vår side Jobb hos oss


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Pleie- og omsorgsoppgaver i hjemmet i henhold til tjenestemottakerens vedtak på tjenester
  • Praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet i henhold til tjenestemottakerens vedtak
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid for å løse ulike oppgaver og yte best mulig tjenester
  • Samarbeid med pårørende
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisert helsefagarbeider
  • Student innen helsefaglig utdanning
  • Student innen andre fagområder enn helse
  • Person med erfaring fra jobb i hjemmetjeneste/helsetjeneste
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige norskkunnskaper
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Engasjement og interesse for å yte tjenester i andre sitt hjem
  • Er glad i andre mennesker
  • Evner å jobbe selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre
  • Liker å jobbe i turnus med dag og kveldsvakter
  • Bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt
Vi tilbyr
  • Opplæring, veiledning og oppfølging
  • Varierte og personlig utviklende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Internundervisning med avdelingsledere, fagutvikler og ressurspersoner ved enheten
  • Turnusarbeid på helg(dag og kveldsvakter)
  • Sommerjobb ved enheten
  • Muligheter for å jobbe som tilkallingsvikar i tillegg til din faste helgestilling
  • Vi tilbyr lønn basert på sentrale tariffavtaler og Trondheim kommunes lokale lønnspolitikk med fagstiger og lokale lønnsmodeller. Lønn avtales ut fra din kompetanse, erfaring og stillingens ansvar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Trondheim kommune 

Trondheim kommune er landets tredje største kommune, og Norges største arbeidsplass nord for Dovre med om lag 15 000 medarbeidere. Sammen jobber vi for å gi byens innbyggere gode helse- og velferdstjenester, oppvekst- og utdanningsmuligheter, kultur- og fritidstilbud og et godt bymiljø. Trondheim kommune håndterer samfunnskritiske oppgaver og informasjon som krever ekstra forsiktighet for å ivareta sikkerheten og tryggheten til innbyggerne og samfunnet. Derfor er det viktig for oss at du som søker er en person vi kan stole på, som tar kloke valg og er lojal mot samfunnsoppdraget. 

Trondheim kommune er en framtidsrettet og moderne arbeidsgiver som samarbeider med byens forsknings-, universitets- og høgskolemiljø. Hos oss finnes det spennende karrieremuligheter innen en svært bredt spekter av fagfelt. Mange av våre medarbeidere har hatt et langt og variert karriereløp internt i organisasjonen. Vi er stadig på utkikk etter nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere. Les mer om Trondheim kommune på vår hjemmeside og siden Jobb hos oss.

Trondheim kommune legger til rette for mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion, etnisitet, eller hull i CV-en. Trondheim kommune tilrettelegger arbeidsforholdene så langt det er mulig.

Deltidsansatte i Trondheim kommune som ønsker utvidelse av sin stilling og som er kvalifisert oppfordres og tilbys her å søke på stillinger som er utlyst. 

Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å benytte Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning gjennomført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (tidligere NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. Det kan søkes om anonymitet, men det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. Offentleglova § 25. 

Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges der det er påkrevd. Gyldig legitimasjon fremvises både på intervju og første arbeidsdag. 

Som en del av vårt samfunnsansvar og vårt arbeid med personellsikkerhet, foretar vi bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater der dette er relevant.

jobs.title: Office Manager Stockholm
jobs.description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.  



Your opportunity

As Office Manager for our Stockholm head office, you will play a key role in creating a professional, welcoming, and engaging workplace experience. You are instrumental in fostering an environment where employees enjoy coming to the office, collaborating with colleagues, and performing at their best.

You are the person who ensures the office runs smoothly every day and that the right conditions are in place for employees, visitors, and business operations. Working independently, you build strong relationships across the organization and serve as a trusted point of contact for a wide range of stakeholders. You are equally comfortable handling strategic initiatives and rolling up your sleeves to solve day-to-day operational challenges. No task is too small, and you take pride in ensuring that everything runs smoothly.



Who you will work with

As Office Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day operations of our Stockholm head office and play a key role in creating a professional, safe, and welcoming workplace for both employees and visitors. You will report to the Executive Assistant to the CEO, have direct people management responsibility for two Receptionists, and work closely with a wide range of functions across the organization.



What you will do

The role combines operational excellence with strategic thinking and is ideal for someone who enjoys creating structure, driving improvements, and delivering a first-class workplace experience. You are comfortable navigating both daily operational needs and larger initiatives that contribute to the continued development of our office environment.



Key responsibilities:

Daily Operations

    Oversee the day-to-day operations of the Stockholm office and reception area.
    Manage and develop two Receptionists, including performance reviews, salary reviews, and workforce planning.

Suppliers & Vendors

    Manage access control systems, locks, alarms, and visitor management processes.
    Serve as the main point of contact for among others, the landlord, cleaning company, security provider, waste management services, plant care provider and coffee supplier.
    Manage supplier relationships, contracts, and procurement of office services and supplies, including cleaning services, office materials, coffee, plants, and temporary staffing.

Health, Safety & Workplace Environment

    As Fire Safety Coordinator you are responsible for coordinating and overseeing the organization's fire safety activities such as fire drills, safety procedures, safety briefings, and employee training.
    Represent the office in the Work Environment Committee and coordinate annual BeSafe activities and initiatives.



Projects & Workplace Development

    Act as the primary internal contact for office relocation and workplace improvement initiatives, coordinating efforts with external project managers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and successful implementation.

Culture & Events

    Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives as wells as workplace activities such as Office Meetings, outdoor exercise activities, after works, and holiday celebrations, to foster a positive and engaging office environment.
    Welcome new employees by coordinating workplace, equipment, company merchandise, and office onboarding activities.

Administration

    Manage office budgets, oversee invoice processing, and ensure effective cost control and financial administration for office-related services and activities.
    A variety of administrative tasks to support day-to-day operations.



What you bring

We are looking for a service-minded and relationship-oriented professional who enjoys creating a welcoming and engaging workplace environment. You are a confident leader who enables others to thrive and perform at their best, while building strong relationships across the organization.

You are highly organized and structured, with strong planning and coordination skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a dynamic environment. Self-motivated and proactive, you take ownership of your work, identify opportunities for improvement, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented and hands-on mindset.

You are comfortable working at a fast pace with many stakeholders and competing priorities, while maintaining a high level of attention to detail. Most importantly, you are passionate about creating a positive office culture and delivering an exceptional workplace experience.

Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken, is required.



Meritorious:

    Experience in project management.
    Experience in health and safety, fire safety, or security-related matters.
    Experience with office relocations or workplace improvement initiatives.



We hire based on experience, knowledge and personality, but also potential. If you’re passionate and eager to learn, we’d love to hear from you, also if you don’t meet every requirement.



Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager, Frida Åsander, frida.asander@boliden.com.

Questions about the application are answered by our Talent Acquisition Partner, Pernilla Åkerblom, Pernilla.Akerblom@boliden.com, +46 73-023 69 61.

For union information, please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70-541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910-77 40 09.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 40 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. If you have several years of work experience within software development and embedded systems and wants to be part of a growing company with world leading products, this is for you!

About the role

Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. Mycronic is divided into four divisions, and in this role, you will belong to PCB Assembly Solutions (PA). PA is a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT) to electronics manufacturers who require rapid production adjustments while maintaining high efficiency. PA delivers systems for circuit board assembly, including both complete line solutions and individual systems for specific process steps, as well as advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. In this role, you will be part of a team of 7 team members and collaborate with several functions across the company, such as architects, project managers and other software teams within for example AI.

You are offered

    The opportunity to work in a multi-cultural company with knowledgeable, friendly and goal-oriented colleagues.
    To work in an exciting company in a growth phase, where you can make a real impact in a fun and dynamic environment. Mycronic is a global company, yet small enough for you to truly make a difference.
    The opportunity to work with world-leading products. The future of electronics production is increasingly complex. Denser boards, a wider range of miniaturized components, more NPIs and erratic production schedules. To address these challenges Mycronic has developed the industry’s fastest, most flexible and most precise jet printing and solder paste dispensing systems. Mycronic jet printing technology makes it possible to dispense solder paste for the most challenging circuit boards and components, with micrometer accuracy, maximum speed and perfect quality solder joints. Read more here: https://www.mycronic.com/product-areas/pcb-assembly/products/smt/jet-printing/.
    Mycronic has a large software organization which will provide you with optimal opportunities to develop your knowledge in various areas of computer science – such as software architecture for robotics, machine learning, AI, optimization, and computer vision.

Work tasks

You will work in a broad developer role where you will truly have the opportunity to influence the final solution of the products. The Mycronic Jet Printer, which is the product area you will be developing the software for, includes electronics, mechanics, and software, creating exciting opportunities for those who want to work with complex software development involving multiple technical disciplines. We are continuously working to enhance our products; user-friendliness, particularly in terms of automation and user interfaces, which will also be part of your development work. Your primary focus will be on improving the products, with opportunities to contribute your ideas and collaborate as a team to create the best solutions. This may involve anything from adding capability features and reducing energy consumption to updating the GUI. Mycronic has both R&D, lab, and production in-house, meaning you will work close to the products you develop, which also gives you the opportunity to see the "real world" results of your work.

We are looking for

This is a role for someone with a strong background in software development and an interest in understanding the entire product and an ambition to grow into a software architect role. As a software developer you will have a key role in the product development since this is where all the technology in the machine comes together to provide the system functionality that meets the user. You will be involved in everything from requirements gathering to design, architecture and development and collaborate with several stakeholders. As a person, we see it as particularly important that you are goal- and detail-oriented and have strong collaboration skills. You also have a will to contribute with your ideas, and just like your colleagues, you always strive to develop yourself and contribute to the team´s collective growth. We expect you to make a strong contribution by adding new functionality, maintaining high quality and by helping to introduce new technology and processes to increase team efficiency.

You likely have:

    A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, electronics, mechatronics, or a similar field.
    Strong software development experience with the capability and ambition to take on broader architectural responsibilities in a few years.
    Knowledge in Java.
    Strong knowledge of software development in Linux.
    Experience of working with software systems that interact with embedded software and hardware.
    Strong knowledge in English and good knowledge in Swedish (or have the desire to learn)

It is considered advantageous if you have:

    Knowledge in C and/or C++

Other Information

    Start date: By agreement
    Employment type: Permanent
    Scope: Full-time
    Location: Kista
    Contact Information: Senior Recruitment Consultant Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se
    The recruitment process is handled by Academic Work, and Mycronic requests that all questions regarding the process goes to Academic Work.

Our recruitment process

    Problem-solving and personality test
    Phone interview with Academic Work
    In-depth interview with Academic Work
    Interviews with Mycronic
    Reference check + decision

jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.
Výhody:13, 14 mzda po odpracovaní 6 mesiacov, mesačné prémie, príspevok na dochádzanie do práce, kredit na občerstvenie, príspevok na stravu nad rámec zákona.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Odborní pracovníci v oblasti predaja poistenia
jobs.employer: KOMUNÁLNA poisťovňa, a.s. Vienna Insurance Group
jobs.description:
Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Vaše pracovné úlohy na uvedenej pracovnej pozícii budú: Aktívne vyhľadávanie klientov a následná starostlivosť o nich. Poistné poradenstvo a vypracovávanie návrhov na poistenie podľa potrieb klienta. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Sprostredkovanie predaja vybraných bankových produktov.
Výhody:Stabilná a zaujímavá práca v najsilnejšej poisťovacej skupine na Slovensku Vienna Insurance Group. 6-mesačný program podpory nových regionálnych obchodných zástupcov s garanciou minimálneho príjmu a provízie bez obmedzenia. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. Ak Vás ponuka zaujala, pošlite nám Váš štruktúrovaný životopis. Kontaktovať budeme len vybraných uchádzačov, ktorí spĺňajú požiadavky danej pozície. Všetky informácie o spracúvaní osobných údajov nájdete na https: www.kpas.sk stranka ochrana-osobnych-udajov.

Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Typická pracovná doba je delená a to od 7:00 hod do 12:00 hod následne 16:00 hod až 21:00 hod (závisí od vyťaženia), pričom sa prispôsobuje aktuálnej prevádzke.
Výhody:Vychutnaj si chutné a kvalitné jedlá v hotelovej reštaurácii za výhodné ceny. V prípade vzdialeného bydliska nad 30 km od hotela poskytujeme ubytovanie 1 € noc. Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Uži si prácu v úspešnej reštaurácii, ktorá je známa svojou kvalitou a štýlovým prostredím. Ak máš záujem, pošli svoj životopis alebo nás kontaktuj osobne v Hoteli GOLFER , Kremnica. jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

AI Engineer (f/m/d) 80\-100%

AI Engineer (f/m/d) 80\-100%
============================



### **Your impact with us**



* You will work in our motivated and solution\-oriented AI Feature Team using agentic development methods and with a high degree of personal responsibility.
* You will design, develop and deploy scalable AI\-enabled features in our products that are used by more than 100’000 customers.

  **Background:**



We are looking for a Principal Project Manager (PM) to manage a range of projects, based on their stage and complexity. This role encompasses a variety of assignments including development pipeline, line extensions, post\-approval, technology, and continuous improvement initiatives. The PM will work independently, effectively prioritizing and managing workload to meet team goals with limited direction. The role includes flexibility for global time zone interactions and occasional travel to external partners for collaboration and planning activities.







**The Perfect Candidate** holds a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field, supported by 8 to 11 years of professional experience, including a minimum of 5 years within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or biopharmaceutical sectors. They should possess significant expertise in managing drug or medical device development and commercialization projects, with a focus on combination products and vendor collaboration. Proficiency in industry\-standard project management tools, such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, and Google Suite, is required, alongside a thorough understanding of 21CFR820\.30 design control requirements. A PMP certification is considered a valuable asset for this role. Fluency in English is required, while proficiency in , Japanese, or Danish is advantageous

Planning: Define "inspection ready" Design \& Development Plans



Execution: Drive team activities to meet project and design control deliverables



Team Dynamics: Ensure effective communication and facilitate team performance in a regulated environment using various processes and tools for planning, communication, budget, schedule, compliance, and risk management

Maintains full understanding of program milestones for the Core, Lifecycle, Technical Development and associated teams and links them to the Device Team plan



Effectively applies PM best practices and utilizes tools for planning, communication, team building, collaboration, decision\-making, issue \& risk management, lessons learned, knowledge management and budget tracking

Ensures transparent communication of key team information and escalates issues as appropriate

Promotes collaborative environment across team members



Facilitates efficient decision\-making and issue resolution



Identifies team risks and mitigation plans



  **Project Planning and Execution:**

Facilitates project plan development and execution, and monitor the project schedule



Integrates deliverables with other teams linked to the product



Ensures effective team dynamics and positive team environments



  **Risk and Issue Management:**

  **Collaboration and Team Building:**

Establish relationships and network with other stakeholder Teams and PMs



  **Communication:**

Acts as Device Team Leader back\-up for Team communication as required



Liaises with other Teams to manage cross\-functional activities and issues and risks



  **Meeting and Budget Management:**



Facilitate effective team meetings with clear outcomes and follow\-up actions



Forecast and monitor team resources and project costs



  **Knowledge Management:**

Manages Team uncontrolled document repository (e.g. Project History )



Conducts lessons learned exercises during project execution and share outcomes to a broader audience



  **Governance:**



Effectively navigates the Device Team through business process stage\-gates



Supports Team Leader with technical advisory and governance committee reviews at pre\-defined check\-in points and/or identifies appropriate check\-in points



  **Continuous Improvement Initiatives:**



Leads business process continuous improvement initiatives through applying project lessons: business process updates, PM tool optimization \& implementation, best practice sharing and driving awareness across teams

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.

In the local Electrification Service business unit, we help our customers secure and extend the availability and lifetime of their electrical assets. Our focus is on service solutions for low\- and medium\-voltage switchgear, emergency power systems, and digital solutions. We combine technical expertise, a strong service mindset, and close collaboration with our customers.



As a Service Support Specialist, you will apply your technical knowledge to develop customer quotations and service solutions. Ideally, you bring practical experience with switchgear or power distribution systems. You will analyze customer requests, clarify technical requirements, and define suitable service solutions. In doing so, you ensure that proposals are technically feasible, commercially competitive, and clearly structured. You will work closely with Service , Project Management, Engineering, and Field Service teams while contributing to the continuous improvement of our quotation process.



The work model for this role is: \#hybrid



**Your Responsibilities**

* Analyze customer inquiries and quotation requests for service, retrofit, and modernization solutions related to electrical switchgear.
* Define the scope of work, main components, and service deliverables based on technical requirements and practical feasibility.
* Assess technical feasibility and solution availability in close collaboration with Engineering, Project Management, and Field Service teams.
* Prepare cost calculations and technical sales documentation to support competitive and risk\-conscious customer proposals.




**Qualifications for the Role**

* Technical education in electrical engineering or equivalent hands\-on experience in a technical environment; further education at technician (TS/HF), university of applied sciences (FH), or university level is an advantage.
* Practical experience with low\-voltage or medium\-voltage switchgear, for example in assembly, commissioning, service, engineering, retrofit, or project execution, is highly valued.
* Strong technical understanding of electrical power distribution, switchgear components, and customer\-focused service solutions.
* Interest in techno\-commercial topics and the ability to translate technical requirements into clear and economically sound customer proposals.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with cost calculations, quotation processes, or costing models is beneficial.
* Independent, structured, team\-oriented, and customer\-focused working style, with good and English communication skills **or** French and English communication skills.




**Benefits**

The ABB Service Division partners with customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and systems. The division’s comprehensive service portfolio includes maintenance, modernization, and consulting services designed to enhance performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help our customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extract maximum value from them, and recover and regenerate products and materials at the end of their life cycle.

Le Service d'anesthésiologie est un service transversal des HUG au cœur du plateau technique. Avec ses 7 unités médicales et une unité de recherche et d'innovation, sa mission vise à assurer le confort et la sécurité des patientes et patients au cours d'actes thérapeutiques ou diagnostiques, médicaux ou chirurgicaux, ainsi que lors des soins post\\-interventionnels, tout en veillant à la bonne prise en charge de la douleur. Plus grand centre de Suisse en nombres d'actes interventionnels assumés par année, le Service d'anesthésiologie est à la pointe des progrès réalisés dans ce domaine. Le service pourvoit également l'enseignement pré\\- et post\\-gradué et continu des infirmiers et infirmières, et des médecins en formation spécialisée. Service de prestations, l'anesthésiologie intervient également dans le domaine de l'antalgie interventionnelle et dans des situations d'urgences vitales intra\\-hospitalières ou pré\\-hospitalières aux côtés du Service des urgences. Infirmier ou Infirmière \\- équipe antalgie \\- 80% à 100% Dans le cadre de votre fonction d'infirmier ou infirmière en charge de l'antalgie intrahospitalière et ambulatoire, vous assurez la prise en charge des patients et patientes présentant des douleurs aiguës, complexes ou chroniques sur tous les secteurs du site Cluse\\-Roseraie. Vous réalisez des évaluations spécialisées de la douleur en analysant ses caractéristiques ainsi que son impact fonctionnel, et accompagnez le ou la patiente dans la compréhension de la douleur chronique. En collaboration étroite avec le ou la médecin, vous adaptez les traitements, surveillez leur efficacité, évaluez l'observance et ajustez la prise en charge afin de prévenir les erreurs de dosage et la chronicisation de la douleur. Vous mettez en place et assurez le suivi de techniques ou de dispositifs antalgiques avancés. Grâce à une approche non médicamenteuse, vous utilisez des techniques complémentaires et la relation d'aide pour favoriser le soulagement physique et psychologique de la douleur. Vous menez des actions d'éducation thérapeutique auprès de la patientèle et de leurs proches pour renforcer l'adhésion thérapeutique, l'autonomie, et identifier les croyances, les ressources ainsi que les facteurs aggravants. jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst Pensum nach Vereinbarung für die Region Buchs gesucht
jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Buchs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Buchs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst

**Pensum:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Buchs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Buchs liegt im westlichen Aargau an der Grenze zu Solothurn und verfügt über eine ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung durch die Bahnlinie sowie gute Autobahnanbindungen. Die Region besticht durch ihre Nähe zu Aarau und Basel, wodurch Sie von einem dynamischen Wirtschaftsraum mit diversen Arbeitsmöglichkeiten profitieren. Die Kombination aus ländlicher Infrastruktur und urbanen Chancen macht Buchs zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort, der Ihnen Mobilität und berufliche Perspektiven bietet.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Buchs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst

Sie arbeiten in einem betreuten Wohnumfeld: Alltag gestalten, begleiten, fördern. Hier zählt die Beziehung ebenso wie die Pflege, denn Lebensqualität entsteht aus beidem. Ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gerne ganzheitlich arbeiten.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Buchs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
In der Region Buchs besteht eine hohe Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Pflegefachkräften mit Diplom HF/FH für stellvertretende Leitungspositionen. Die demografische Entwicklung und der Fachkräftemangel eröffnen Ihnen ausgezeichnete Karrierechancen mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen. Als etablierter Personalvermittler unterstützt Sie iPersonal durch umfassende Netzwerkbeziehungen zu lokalen Gesundheitseinrichtungen und professionelle Begleitung beim Bewerbungsprozess. So gelingt Ihnen der erfolgreiche Einstieg in eine anspruchsvolle Position.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Buchs

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Stv. Leitung Pflegedienst in Buchs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
