jobs.title: Are you curious how your favorite ice cream is produced – and interested in developing training that can help others understand as well?
jobs.description:
Are you curious how your favorite ice cream is produced – and interested in developing training that can help others understand as well?

At Gram Equipment, we are looking for a student worker to our Gram Equipment Academy team, where we develop high-quality online training on our ice cream processing equipment – for internal as well as external use.

Your primary responsibility will be to translate our existing trainings into German learning experiences, review and update existing trainings and contribute to the development of new training.

You will have the opportunity to get in-depth knowledge about how the specific machine contributes to the production of ice cream, and turn it into training, that is understandable for machine operators from customer sites all around the world.


This will require that you focus on:
  • German translation. Your main focus will be to transform existing English training into clear, engaging and technically accurate German content.
  • Project management.: You will get full responsibility for managing your own projects according to the goals, we set together, and we will have short weekly follow ups to coordinate your progress.
  • Stakeholder collaboration. You will have to coordinate and meet with colleagues from across the organization to gather knowledge and feedback that ensures that the training includes all important aspects and addresses the needs of both customers and your colleagues.
  • Follow and bring new ideas to the existing process for developing training. The process stretches from gathering knowledge, through writing a script and finding visuals, to developing the training using text, pictures, videos and other interactive elements.
  • Content creation. You will have to use creativity and writing skills to produce engaging and effective online training for our customers, using our authoring tool Genially. Templates and previous trainings are available for support and inspiration.
  • Quality Assurance. Ensure that the training is correct, of high quality and that the user experience is consistent.
  • Support the continuous development of Gram Equipment Academy.


Though you will have to work independently, we consider it a team effort to be able to provide training, so support and sparring are always within arm’s length. In general, our team is characterized by an optimistic atmosphere and an informal, humoristic tone.


We do not have any specific requirements for your education. However, we are working with technically complex ice cream processing equipment, so it will be an advantage if you either have some technical understanding of machines and processes – or at least a strong curiosity and willingness to learn.


You must also have an interest in and capabilities for developing the learning material and ensuring its quality.


In addition, we do require the following:
  • Personality: A self-driven team player with an optimistic and proactive work attitude and strong interpersonal communication skills – since you must be able to collaborate with colleagues from across the organization.
  • Creative thinking: We appreciate input that drives change and that has the potential to improve our content, as well as the way we work.
  • Language: Our company language is English. So, you must be able to communicate in English, both spoken and written, including the mediation of technical aspects. In addition, German language skills are essential, and you must be able to write clear German and handle technical terminology with precision.
  • Skills: Some technical understanding of equipment, graphic capabilities and a visual eye for the detail.
  • Work approach: Self-driven, proactive, flexible, structured, and quality-focused.


We expect the average working hours to be 10 to 15 per week, preferably in the office for the purpose of collaboration, but also for the social aspect. The date of employment and your hour distribution will be adapted to your studies.


The position is located at our main office in Kolding, where you will find an informal atmosphere between good and dedicated colleagues.


Application:

Please send your application and CV as soon as possible. Feel free to add any other relevant attachments showing your past work. If you have any questions for the position, please do not hesitate to reach out to Learning & Development Specialist, Cristian Buita on +45 20 82 02 64 or CRBU@gram-equipment.com, or Business Developer Teamlead, Line Andersen on +45 53 66 74 21 or LSAN@gram-equipment.com.


Gram Equipment A/S offers

Gram Equipment A/S is the global leading supplier of advanced equipment and process installations for industrial ice production. With an extensive global network of subsidiaries, agents, sales- and service offices and around 600 employees worldwide, Gram Equipment has the optimal base for fulfilling our customers’ demands.

The company is constantly striving to extend the portfolio of innovative solutions. We aim to ensure that our customers always can react fast to the demands from their customers and consumers worldwide.

Our vision: We ensure our customers’ success in the ice cream industry by providing innovative solutions and services, while seeking to minimize the environmental impact of our solutions and footprint.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Software Engineering: Program Analysis and Repository Mining
jobs.description:
A 2-year postdoctoral researcher position is available at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in the Software Engineering section of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI). The successful candidate will contribute to the VILLUM Experiment project “Is Correctness Necessary? An Experiment in Test-Free Program Repair.” The project investigates whether software bugs can be repaired using information found in the code itself, without relying on test suites or specifications. The position is available from February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Project Description

Generating code is becoming cheap; establishing whether it is correct is not. Large language models can now produce and modify software at remarkable speed, and practices such as “vibe coding” are widening the gap between code generation and validation. Requiring a carefully designed test suite or specification for every generated fragment is unlikely to scale. Yet most automated repair techniques depend on exactly such a correctness oracle: without a failing test or specification, they have neither a clear repair target nor a way to assess a proposed change.

This project challenges that dependency by investigating whether software bugs can be repaired using evidence already present in the code. It will combine program analysis with patterns mined from existing software to explore whether multiple, independent sources of evidence can guide repair when tests or specifications are unavailable. The approach will be studied across different programming languages and evaluated on both real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants. The broader aim is to determine when code contains enough information to support its own repair and when knowledge of the intended behavior remains essential.

 

What we offer 

We offer a dynamic and supportive research environment within an internationally recognized institute. You will join an open, collaborative team that values teamwork, professional diligence, and innovation. The Software Engineering section provides flexible work conditions and strong support for individual development, including mentorship and opportunities to expand your skills and responsibilities.

As part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, our section is involved in a variety of national and European research projects and enjoys a robust network of academic and industrial partners. This position provides an opportunity to engage with these collaborations and work on real-world challenges. We encourage and support our postdocs to publish their research in renowned journals and conferences, and to engage in knowledge exchange with colleagues and external research and industrial partners. The working language is English, and we pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive, and inspiring workplace that fosters personal and professional growth.

 

What we expect 

The appointed researcher will investigate whether software defects can be repaired without relying on test suites or specifications. The candidate will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of a framework that combines program analysis with patterns mined from existing software. The work will involve experiments with real-world bugs and code modified by AI coding assistants across multiple programming languages. We are looking for a highly motivated candidate who meets the following qualifications and characteristics:

  • A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Programming Languages, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

  • Research experience or a strong interest in one or more of the following areas: program analysis, mining software repositories, automated software engineering, software testing, or software repair.

  • An interest in software reliability challenges arising from AI-generated and AI-modified code.

  • Experience with empirical evaluation, software repositories, or bug benchmarks is an advantage.

  • Experience with one or more of C, Java, and Python is an advantage.

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English, with good communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team.

  • A strong research record or demonstrated research potential through publications or other relevant research outputs.

 

Workplace description 

The postdoc will be employed in the Software Engineering section at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), SDU. MMMI is an internationally recognized research institute within the Faculty of Engineering, known for its contributions to software engineering, robotics, and artificial intelligence. The Software Engineering section encompasses a range of research areas in software development, data analytics, and intelligent systems, and it plays a key role in several ongoing European projects.

Our workplace is truly international and collaborative. Researchers in the section come from diverse backgrounds and work closely together on cross-disciplinary projects. We benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and a strong administrative and technical support structure. The institute maintains close collaboration with other departments and centers at SDU, as well as with industry partners, providing a vibrant environment where theoretical research meets practical application. The position will be located on SDU’s Odense campus, which offers an attractive setting and a rich campus life in the city of Odense, Denmark’s hub for robotics and technology development.

 

Further information 

For further information, please contact Associate Professor Abhishek Tiwari (abti@mmmi.sdu.dk) or Assistant Professor Jyoti Prakash (jyp@mmmi.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from February 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Kreativ og fagligt stærk kantinemedarbejder i rollen som stedfortræder
jobs.description:
Vi søger en kantinemedarbejder til kantinen på Campus Holbæk, der brænder for arbejdet i en kantine. Vi søger dig, der har lyst til at være en del af et udviklende, solidarisk og omsorgsfuldt arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdergruppen lægger vægt på trivsel og samhørighed.

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon har vi et ønske om at have levende campusmiljøer og sætte vores studerende i centrum. Dette kommer især til udtryk i vores kantiner, hvor vores studerende hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid mad. Vi er løbende i dialog med de studerende rundt om buffeten i kantinen. Dette gør vi for at sikre, at de måltider, som vi serverer for de studerende, falder i deres smag og giver dem lyst til at samles i vores kantinemiljøer.

Din profil
Du skal som stedfortræder i kantinen være fagligt stærk og bidrage med ny inspiration i en travl hverdag, blandt andet i forhold til produktudvikling, smag og sanser. Derudover skal du have lyst til at være i et miljø med mange studerende, og du skal kunne træde ind og fungere i en koordinerende rolle, når kantinelederen ikke er til stede. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende profil:

Bæredygtigt fokus. Du har erfaring med at være i en kantine, hvor der er fokus på økologi, bæredygtighed og reduktion af madspild. Dit engagement for bæredygtighed i køkkenet kommer blandt andet til udtryk ved, at du har lyst og evne til at dele dine gode ideer og samtidig suger til dig, når du selv har mulighed for at opnå ny viden.

Overblik og omstillingsparat. I en hverdag med mange opgaver, der skal planlægges og følges op på, kan du træffe kvalificerede beslutninger, omsætte dem til handling og samtidig bevare overblikket. Du går struktureret til dine opgaver og løser dem med præcision og omhyggelighed. Du er ansvarsbevidst, serviceminded og engageret, både i forhold til opgaver og samarbejde. Blæser forandringens vinde, går du gerne forrest med en positiv tilgang.

Gode samarbejdsevner. Du evner at arbejde sammen med mange forskellige mennesker på tværs af faggrupper. Du har også evnen og lysten til en hverdag, der rummer det brede arbejdsmarked, hvilket f.eks. omfatter kolleger, der er ansat i virksomhedspraktik.

Erfaring med LEAN. Du har erfaring med LEAN som arbejdsredskab, og du har med egne øjne set eksempler på, hvordan det ved hjælp af LEAN er muligt at frigive tid og ressourcer til andre vigtige gøremål i en travl hverdag.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:
  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk
  • har kendskab til Office-pakken på brugerniveau
  • har erfaring fra lignende stillinger i en kantine eller køkken.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som kantinemedarbejder kommer du til at arbejde med følgende opgaver:

Udvikling i dagligdagen. I en travl hverdag får du en vigtig rolle, når vi skal udvikle arbejdsgange eller finde på nye spændende måder at anvende appelsinskræller eller broccolistokke på i forsøget på at opnå et endnu mere bæredygtigt fokus.

Deltage i kantinens drift. Du skal være med til at producere kolde og varme retter såvel som brød, kager og meget andet, som vi sælger i kantinen. Du skal også være med til at planlægge menuen og bestille varer hjem, samt være med til at modtage varerne, når disse leveres. Derudover skal du i løbet af en dag ekspedere i kantinens salgsområde og foretage egenkontrol.

Sørge for kursister og gæster. På vores campus har vi en del kurser og konferencer for interne såvel som eksterne virksomheder og organisationer. Du har i forbindelse med kurser og konferencer en vigtig rolle i forhold til, at kursister og gæster får den rette forplejning på det rigtige tidspunkt, så de føler, at servicen er i top.

Stedfortræder for leder. Du skal drive køkkenet i samarbejde med dine kolleger og bevare overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften. Som stedfortræder forventes det, at du kan bestille varer, sikre en velfungerende kantinedrift og træffe beslutninger på lederens vegne, når det er nødvendigt.

Dine kolleger
Kantinen på Campus Holbæk er et team bestående af en ansvarlig kok/kantinemedarbejder og en kantinemedarbejder. Du refererer til vores kantineleder på Campus Kalundborg, hvor der også kan forekomme vagter. Hos os går vi op i kvalitet, at der er en uformel omgangstone, og at det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Alle campusser i Absalon har tilknyttet en eller flere kantiner, hvor studerende og ansatte hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid. Dine kolleger har et stort fokus på, at deres arbejde ikke kun er madproduktion og salg - kantinen er det uformelle samlingspunkt på campus og altid et rart sted at være. Vi arbejder i teams, og selvom vi er spredt på forskellige campusser, samarbejder vi på tværs og går op i at skabe holdånd og fællesskab, uanset om du arbejder i Holbæk, Slagelse, Vordingborg eller på en af de øvrige campusser.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund og anciennitet vil en forventet løn ligge mellem 29.000 kr. og 32.000 kr. pr. måned ekskl. pension. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 15%, 16% eller 18,4% afhængigt af din uddannelsesbaggrund. Din løn bliver sammensat af basisløn, funktionstillæg og evt. kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid, og vi vil gerne have, at du begynder den 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter.
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Søren Loui Frydensberg, der kan træffes dagligt fra kl. 13.00 - 15.00 på tlf.: 7248 2253 eller mail skre@pha.dk.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 19. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 23. oktober 2026 og 2. ansættelsessamtale den 26. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

Teamleder til kørselsafdeling

Teamleder til kørselsafdelingen - skab struktur, fremdrift og stærke leverancer

Har du blik for både mennesker, logistik og den gode drift?

Trives du med at skabe struktur i en hverdag, hvor planer kan ændre sig hurtigt- og motiveres du af at få medarbejdere, biler og leverancer til at spille sammen?

Hos Idealcombi søger vi nu en handlekraftig og struktureret teamleder til vores kørselsafdeling, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige ledelse og sikre en effektiv kørselsplanlægning til vores kunder i Danmark og på eksportmarkederne.

Om stillingen

Som teamleder får du det daglige ansvar for kørselsafdelingen og vores chauffører. Du bliver en central del af den daglige drift og får ansvaret for at sikre, at vores leverancer planlægges og gennemføres effektivt, og at kunderne får den rette information undervejs.

Du er tæt på medarbejderne og den operationelle hverdag og skal kunne bevare overblikket, prioritere og træffe beslutninger, når virkeligheden ændrer sig. Samtidig får du en lederopgave, hvor du gennem løbende dialog, opfølgning og udvikling sikrer et velfungerende og motiveret team.

Kørselsafdelingen har en stor kontaktflade på tværs af Idealcombi, og du kommer særligt til at samarbejde med produktion, salg og øvrige interne funktioner. Derfor er det afgørende, at du kommunikerer tydeligt og formår at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer, både internt og eksternt.

Dine primære ansvarsområder vil blandt andet være:
  • Planlægning og koordinering af kørsel for både Danmark og eksport
  • Sikre leveringsadvisering til kunder og opfølgning på restordrer
  • Daglig ledelse og udvikling af medarbejderne i kørselsafdelingen og vores chauffører
  • Sikre god koordinering og kommunikation med kunder, chauffører og interne samarbejdspartnere

Du bliver også ansvarlig for, at vores ledelsessystem og relevante personalepolitikker efterleves i afdelingen, og at teamet løbende har de rette kompetencer til at løse opgaverne.

Din profil

Du er en synlig leder, der trives tæt på driften og medarbejderne. Du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og har gennemslagskraft, når der skal prioriteres og træffes beslutninger.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have mange års formel ledererfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har forståelse for transport, logistik eller kørselsplanlægning og samtidig har lysten og evnen til at tage ansvar for både mennesker og drift.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med kørselsplanlægning, transport, logistik eller disponering
  • Gerne har en relevant baggrund som fx kørselsdisponent, speditør eller lignende
  • Har ledererfaring, eller er klar til at tage næste skridt ind i en lederrolle
  • Arbejder systematisk og struktureret og er stærk i din opfølgning
  • Har gennemslagskraft og bevarer overblikket i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag
  • Er god til at kommunikere og skabe relationer på tværs af organisationen
  • Har erfaring med ERP-systemer og er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer
  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk i skrift og tale

Vi tilbyder

Hos Idealcombi får du en central rolle i en funktion, der har stor betydning for både vores kunder og den daglige drift.

Du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på kørselsafdelingen og være med til løbende at udvikle både medarbejdere, arbejdsgange og samarbejdet på tværs af virksomheden.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:
  • En selvstændig lederrolle med ansvar og mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel
  • En varieret hverdag, hvor drift, ledelse, planlægning og problemløsning går hånd i hånd
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde og ordentlighed vægtes højt
  • En lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer, inkl. pension og sundhedsordning

Kontakt og ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabrikschef Allan Sørensen på tlf. 96 88 24 85 eller mail als@idealcombi.dk.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV snarest muligt. Ansøgninger behandles løbende og fortroligt, og vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 08-11-2026.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Om Idealcombi

Idealcombi har, siden det første vindue blev fremstillet i 1973, haft domicil i Thy. Hovedsædet i Hurup rummer i dag 100.000 m² til produktion og administration med mere end 400 ansatte.

Herfra har Idealcombi gennem mere end 50 år fremstillet vinduer og yderdøre i høj kvalitet. Innovation er et grundlæggende omdrejningspunkt i virksomheden, og vi arbejder kontinuerligt og målrettet på at være blandt de førende inden for udviklingen af vinduer og døre til nutidens og fremtidens behov.

Design, funktion, energiforbrug og en optimal miljøvenlig produktion er blandt de væsentligste parametre - og vores medarbejderes kompetencer er afgørende for, at vi lykkes.

We operate a highly progressive, fast-paced commercial dairy enterprise with 800 crossbred cows across two geographically separate farm blocks in Co. Waterford. We are seeking an individual to fill the role of Dairy Farm Assistant. Please note that this is an intensive, physically demanding role in a remote rural environment. The position requires a strict roster system that includes mandatory early mornings, late evenings, weekends, and public holiday shifts. Core Duties & Work Environment: Early Morning Milking Operations: Executing daily milking procedures starting at 5:00 AM sharp, maintaining strict hygiene and herd movement protocols. Livestock Care & Intensive Calving Support: Assisting with calf rearing, intensive feeding, tagging, and monitoring herd health indicators under the farm plan. Grassland Management: Conducting weekly manual grass measurements and field pacing to update farm feeding plans. Outdoor Manual Labour: Performing routine farm maintenance, fencing, power-washing, and yard cleaning in all outdoor seasonal weather conditions. Strict Candidate Prerequisites: Reliable Transport: Due to the early 5:00 AM start times and the remote, rural location of the farm units in Co Waterford, candidates must have access to their own reliable private transport. Public transport is not available to these locations. Roster Flexibility: Total availability to work a rotating roster that includes weekends and public holidays is non-negotiable. Physical Fitness: The role involves continuous lifting, walking, and heavy manual handling outdoors. Core Competencies: High level of reliability, honesty, absolute punctuality, and the ability to follow strict livestock safety protocols. Benefits: On-site parking available. To be considered for this position, applicants must submit a fully updated CV alongside a detailed cover letter explaining their specific interest in large-scale spring calving operations. Incomplete applications or applications missing a cover letter will not be reviewed.

All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

  • har god situationsfornemmelse og sætter en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver
  • har praktisk sans og hænderne skruet godt på

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:
  • klargøring af kirken og medvirken ved gudstjenester og kirkelige handlinger
  • rengøring og almindelig vedligeholdelse af kirken og sognegården
  • pasning af kirkens udendørsarealer
  • opstilling og flytning af borde og stole i forbindelse med arrangementer
  • indkøb og lagerstyring
  • opsyn med håndværkere, tekniske installationer og øvrig drift
  • andre praktiske opgaver, der bidrager til kirkens daglige liv

Stillingen indebærer fysisk arbejde, og det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med praktiske opgaver.

Vi arbejder løbende på at udvikle kirkens drift og skabe gode rammer for kirketjenernes arbejde. Blandt andet ønsker vi at skabe mulighed for ekstra ressourcer til særlige opgaver som hovedrengøring og større vedligeholdelsesopgaver, ligesom vi ser på mere bæredygtige løsninger i plejen af kirkens udearealer.

Vi tilbyder
  • et alsidigt og meningsfuldt arbejde i en levende kirke
  • gode og engagerede kolleger
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar og udvikling
  • mulighed for at præge stillingens fremtidige indhold

Ansættelse sker ved Ordrup Sogns Menighedsråd beliggende Henrik Hertz Vej 1, 2920 Charlottenlund.

Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Aftalerne kan ses på Folkekirkens IntraNet.

Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 324.667,- kr. – 408.841,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling).

OK tillæg på 1.401,- kr. (nutidskroner for fuldtidsstilling) pr. år.

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.

Løn OK tillæg samt rådighedstillæg kvoteres i overensstemmelse med stillingens ansættelsesbrøk.

Hvis du ikke er uddannet kirketjener, er det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for kirketjenere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

·       Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million

·       Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics

·       Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases

·       Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements

·       Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level

·       Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments

·       Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance

·       Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

·       Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option

·       Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate

·       The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently

·       The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers

·       The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages

·       The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications

·       A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

·       A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development

·       A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group

·       Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation

·       Good opportunities for both professional and personal development

·       Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance

·       A good canteen scheme and active staff association

·       An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Enterprise
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 25,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and now expanding across Asia Pacific. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. You’ll play an instrumental role in defining our enterprise sales motion, contribute to the future of our product, and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role in APAC is office based 2–3 days per week, as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region.

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly targets

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts; understand client needs deeply, align Linear’s solutions to business objectives + shape decision criteria. Effectively communicate and align our value proposition to decision-makers

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

 - Help build the foundation and define our enterprise sales process

Requirements

 - 3+ years selling to the enterprise, and 7+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling a technical product to both engineering and product leadership; bonus if you have experience selling collaboration or project management software

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Ability to understand complex client needs, craft tailored discovery, and drive sales through consultative approaches.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

Vos tâches et missions :

Vous gérez les différents stocks à partir d'un programme informatisé :
• Organisation des stocks : classement et rangement du matériel commandé de façon ordonnée et logique

• Propreté des stocks et du parc de recyclage

Vous supervisez et contrôlez les entrées et sorties de stock :

• Remontée et signalement des problèmes

Vous préparez le matériel à livrer / pour les chantiers :
• Vérification du matériel pour chaque chantier
• Préparation des éléments annexes et de l'approvisionnement en consommables

Votre profil :
• Expérience minimale de 5 ans comme gestionnaire des stocks / magasinier
• Excellentes connaissances de la gestion des espaces et du stock
• Bonnes connaissances des logiciels de gestion et d'inventaire
• Connaissance du domaine de la fermeture extérieure / serrurerie (atout)
• Sens de l'organisation, de la planification et des priorités
• Être réactif et doté d'un sens inné de l'adaptation
• Faire preuve de persévérance
• Être résistant au stress
• Suivi des formations continues sur les produits et techniques en constante évolution dans le secteur de la menuiserie extérieure / serrurerie
• Suivi des formations sur les processus et procédures internes de la société
• Respecter ses supérieurs hiérarchiques et ses collègues
• Maîtrise du français, du luxembourgeois et de l'allemand
• Connaissance des logiciels bureautiques et du réseau partagé : Outlook, Word, Excel, Adobe Acrobat
• Adhésion aux valeurs de l'entreprise

Nous vous proposons :

jobs.title: IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in the domain of IoT communication connectivity and associated services. We are a venture capital-backed company with a successful track record of satellite launches and the first company in the world to disrupt the telecommunications industry by merging cellular 5G with satellites.
Our technology has massive implications for the Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport sectors, particularly in the management and tracking of assets in remote and rural areas and in extending 5G coverage through non-terrestrial networks.
As our wireless technologies continue to evolve and earn multiple awards, with funding for the next phase secured and strong commercial traction demonstrated, we are now looking to onboard an experienced IT Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administrator to strengthen and manage our cloud-first IT infrastructure.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing and supporting our modern IT environment across Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtualization platforms, ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and reliability of our systems. You will play a key role in maintaining a secure, resilient, and well-documented infrastructure, driving infrastructure modernization initiatives, supporting users across the organization, and enabling the continued growth and success of OQ Technology.

Job Responsibilities

• Administer and support all types of endpoints (Windows, Mac, Linux, and mobile) across the organization.
• Manage and support Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, conditional access, backups, and monitoring.
• Manage identity, access, and device management (Entra ID, Intune, MDM).
• Support secure collaboration tools (Microsoft 365, file sharing, conferencing), SharePoint Online administration, and licensing management (including CSP/NCE transitions).
• Maintain and optimize virtualization platforms (Proxmox or other hypervisors) and containerized environments where applicable.
• Manage and support AWS infrastructure, including provisioning, monitoring, and maintaining EC2 instances and related resources.
• Handle user and access management on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Support and maintain secure remote access (OpenVPN, bastion hosts, jump servers) and general network infrastructure (switches, firewalls, VLANs, routing).
• Support system availability, performance, patching, and lifecycle management across cloud platforms.
• Manage backup and disaster recovery operations using Veeam, ensuring reliable backup jobs, retention policies, and recovery testing.
• Maintain and support self-hosted or cloud-based GitHub/GitLab instances, including user access, repository administration, and general upkeep.
• Apply security-by-design principles across all IT systems; support compliance with relevant standards (e.g. ISO 27001) and internal security policies.
• Assist with vulnerability management, patching, audits, and risk assessments.
• Participate in infrastructure planning, upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
• Troubleshoot complex system and virtualization issues across cloud environments.
• Provide Level 2/3 escalation support for the helpdesk team and end users.
• Document system configurations, procedures, architectures, and operational standards.
• Manage IT-related purchases (hardware, software licenses, cloud credits) in collaboration with procurement, and track asset lifecycle to optimize spend.
• Develop working knowledge of Linux systems and assist with Linux-based workloads as needed.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience as a Systems Administrator or in a comparable IT infrastructure/operations role in a corporate environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with Azure/Microsoft 365 administration (Entra ID, SharePoint Admin Center, conditional access, licensing).
• Solid understanding of virtualization concepts (Proxmox, Hyper-V, or similar).
• Experience managing AWS resources (EC2 instances and related services); familiarity with GCP user/access management is a plus.
• Solid networking knowledge, including OpenVPN administration, switches, firewalls, VLANs, and routing (TCP/IP).
• Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and system monitoring solutions (Veeam experience is a strong plus).
• Comfortable working with enterprise ticketing systems (e.g. Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk) for incident and request management.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a preference for clear, GUI-driven administration tools where practical.
• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent documentation skills — comfortable producing clear operational guides and handover documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting or administering Linux systems, or strong willingness to learn.
• Familiarity with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, or comparable) as a complement to GUI-based administration.
• Exposure to containerization (Docker) and infrastructure automation tools (Ansible, Terraform).
• Familiarity with maintaining GitHub/GitLab instances (user management, repository administration).
• Experience working within an international organization, comfortable navigating diverse cultures and multiple time zones.
• Relevant certifications (Microsoft, Azure) are a plus.

Additional Information:

As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What We Offer

• A hands-on role with ownership across the full cloud IT stack and security.
• Direct exposure to infrastructure modernization and licensing/procurement decisions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

jobs.title: Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Job Location:  LUXEMBOURG
Starting Date:  Start Immediately
Job Type:  UNLIMITED

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

What we offer:

• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary – an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.
• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.
• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.
• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.
• Regular company events and team activities.

jobs.title: OPERATEUR AMIANTE F/H
jobs.description:
Fort des compétences de sa filiale de démolition XARDEL, acquise en 2011, le Groupe COSTANTINI est en mesure de réaliser tous types de travaux de démolition et de déconstruction sélective, jusqu'au tri et la revalorisation des matériaux.


Avec un parc matériel spécifique de plus de 30 machines et une équipe d'opérateurs confirmés, nous sommes capables de proposer des solutions techniques à des démolitions d'immeubles de plus de 30 mètres de hauteur, des ouvrages d'art de tous types, des usines, des maisons individuelles ou même des démolitions intérieures pour réhabilitation.


Nous sommes également en mesure de réaliser des travaux de désamiantage intérieurs ou extérieurs dans le cadre de nos opérations.


La démolition est un métier technique et parfois complexe. Nous avons le savoir-faire et les moyens techniques pour vous accompagner dans vos travaux futurs.


Pour renforcer son équipe de Niederkorn (LU), XARDEL recherche un Opérateur Amiante F/H


Responsabilités :


L'Opérateur Amiante F/H effectue le retrait des matériaux amiantés en respectant strictement les consignes de la hiérarchie.

Voici vos missions :

    Mettre en place les installations de chantier (balisage, confinement, dépression, SAS) et préparer le terrain, les outils, les matériaux nécessaires à l'exécution des travaux,

    Réaliser les travaux de retrait des matériaux contenant de l'amiante dans le respect du plan de retrait établi,

    Repérer, séparer et enlever les différents matériaux : bois, métaux, bardages, déchets inertes (plastique, revêtement) sous la directive du chef de chantier,

    Effectuer les opérations de décontamination (personnelle, matériels, zones) en respectant les consignes de sécurité,

    Assurer le conditionnement, l'étiquetage et l'évacuation des déchets amiantés,

    Renseigner les documents de suivi de chantier (traçabilité, rapports) et rendre compte à la hiérarchie de l'avancement des travaux,

    Utiliser et entretenir les appareils de protection respiratoire et les équipements de protection individuelle (EPI) et collective (EPC).


Compétences requises :

    Connaissance des risques liés à l'amiante (toxicité, pathologies associées, réglementation),

    Lecture et compréhension des modes opératoires (plan de retrait, notice de poste, procédures SS4),

    Savoir reconnaître les matériaux susceptibles de contenir de l'amiante,

    Respect strict des consignes de sécurité (EPI, confinements, décontamination),

    Capacité à utiliser le matériel spécifique (aspirateurs à filtration absolue, unités de décontamination, équipements de confinement),

    Communication et remontée d'informations (alerte en cas de situation à risque),

    Habile de ses mains, disponible et doté·e d'une bonne résistance physique.


Compétences utiles :

    La possession d'ACS/CACES engins de chantier et/ou d'une formation amiante SS3 ou SS4 est considérée comme un atout,

    Connaissance des normes de sécurité.


Nous offrons :

    Un poste à pourvoir immédiatement dans une entreprise dynamique et en pleine croissance,

    Rémunération selon profil et expérience,

    Mutuelle Santé obligatoire et prise en charge à 100%,

    Parcours de formation

Vous intégrerez l'équipe UC Cisco & Applications de XXXX S.A. en tant qu'ingénieur senior, et prendrez en charge les solutions de Communications Unifiées Cisco et Microsoft Teams sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie — de l'architecture et la conception jusqu'à l'implémentation et le dépannage avancé.
Vous serez le référent technique et le point d'escalade pour les projets et incidents complexes, en intervenant à la fois sur nos propres plateformes et sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région, dans un environnement professionnel exigeant nécessitant rigueur, autonomie, sens du service et bonne gestion des priorités.

Rôle principal

Dans le cadre de vos activités, vous serez notamment amené à:  

• Concevoir des solutions de communications unifiées (Cisco UC, SIP, Microsoft Teams) adaptées aux besoins des clients, en produisant des dossiers d'architecture de haut et bas niveau (HLD/LLD).
• Piloter l'implémentation et le déploiement des solutions UC:  clusters CUCM, passerelles voix, SBC/CUBE, trunks SIP, téléphones IP Cisco, Jabber/Webex, messagerie vocale et téléphonie Microsoft Teams.
• Définir et construire les plans de numérotation, le routage d'appels, les plans de numéros et les politiques de classe de service sur plusieurs sites.
• Agir comme point d'escalade de niveau 3:  diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents complexes voix, réseau et UC.
• Prendre en charge la sécurité UC:  certificats et PKI, TLS/SRTP, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL, clusters en mixed-mode) et prévention de la fraude téléphonique (toll fraud).
• Intégrer la UC à l'écosystème environnant:  AD/LDAP, présence, messagerie vocale, supervision et outils de ticketing.
• Piloter les migrations et montées de version, y compris les scénarios Cisco vers Teams et de téléphonie hybride.
• Assurer un leadership technique et le mentorat des techniciens et ingénieurs juniors, et contribuer aux bonnes pratiques internes.
• Assurer l'interface avec les clients, les fournisseurs et les équipes internes, en garantissant la qualité, une communication claire et le respect des délais projet.
• Produire et maintenir une documentation technique claire (dossiers de conception, configurations, as-built et procédures d'exploitation).

Profil recherché

Titulaire d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique, réseaux ou télécommunications (niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou justifiant d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente, vous disposez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans des projets de communications unifiées, dans un rôle combinant conception, implémentation et support.
Vous avez une capacité avérée à concevoir une solution, à l'implémenter et à la dépanner de bout en bout, et vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler en autonomie dans un environnement structuré et orienté client, avec un haut niveau d'exigence. Vous savez gérer les priorités et garder une communication professionnelle et claire en toute circonstance.
Les certifications Cisco (CCNP Collaboration / CCIE Collaboration) sont fortement appréciées ; les certifications Microsoft (Teams / Microsoft 365) sont un plus.

Compétences

• L'expertise Cisco Unified Communications est obligatoire : connaissance approfondie de CUCM, Unity Connection, IM&P, Jabber, Webex, téléphones IP Cisco, passerelles voix et SBC/CUBE.
• Maîtrise approfondie du protocole SIP (signalisation, négociation SDP, dépannage) et des flux média RTP/SRTP.
• Solides connaissances en sécurité UC et gestion des certificats: TLS, SRTP, PKI et gestion des certificats, enregistrement sécurisé (CTL/ITL), clusters en mixed-mode et lutte contre la fraude téléphonique.
• Socle réseau IT solide: TCP/IP, VLAN, DHCP, DNS, routage et QoS voix de bout en bout.
• La téléphonie Microsoft Teams est idéale: Teams Phone, Direct Routing, intégration SBC, politiques de routage voix et scénarios hybrides Cisco/Teams.
• Conception et ingénierie de solutions : design de plan de numérotation, haute disponibilité et redondance, Call Admission Control et dimensionnement.
• Dépannage avancé à l'aide des traces SIP/SDL, de RTMT, du Dialed Number Analyzer et de captures réseau (Wireshark).
• Compétences en gestion de projet et en documentation : capacité à piloter des projets techniques et à produire une documentation claire et structurée.

Langues

• Maîtrise du français requise, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
• Bon niveau d'anglais requis (documentation et échanges techniques).
• La maîtrise du luxembourgeois est un atout.

Environnement de travail

Le poste est basé au Luxembourg et combine des activités de projet et de conception avec des interventions sur site chez nos clients au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité, la précision et la communication sont essentielles.
Ce poste conviendra à un professionnel expérimenté souhaitant prendre en charge des projets complexes de communications unifiées, approfondir son expertise sur les solutions

Cisco et Microsoft, et devenir un référent technique au sein d'un intégrateur ICT de premier plan.

Ce que nous proposons

• Un CDI à temps complet.
• Un package attractif.
• Un cycle continu de formation et la possibilité d'évoluer dans l'entreprise.
• Une équipe dynamique et soudée créant un cadre de travail très agréable.
• Une société où l'employé et le client sont au cœur de toutes les attentions.
• Un groupe leader dont le siège au Luxembourg facilite l'adéquation entre organisation, solutions et attente du marché.

Contraintes éventuelles liées au poste:  Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

À propos de XXXX Group

Fondé en 1929 au Luxembourg, XXXX Group compte actuellement plus de 150 collaborateurs dans de multiples domaines d'activités et actifs dans les secteurs de la finance (agrément PSF), la santé, l'hôtellerie, l'industrie, les services, le secteur public et les Institutions européennes.
XXXX Group (XXXX, XXXX Security, XXXX Telecom et XXXX Soft) fournit des solutions d'intégration ICT, de services Cloud, de sécurité des bâtiments, d'intégration audiovisuelle et d'opérateur téléphonique au Luxembourg et dans la Grande Région ainsi qu'une large palette de solutions IT et un service d'éditeur d'applications métiers.
Nous accompagnons les administrations, les grandes entreprises et les PME avec la même vision claire : se poser en partenaire fiable, flexible et innovant.

Comment postuler
Vous possédez les qualités requises ci-dessus? Veuillez s'il vous plaît envoyer votre lettre de motivation et votre curriculum vitae (en français ou en anglais) à l'adresse jobs@XXXX.com en indiquant « Candidature au poste d'Ingénieur Senior en Communications Unifiées (H/F) ».
Votre candidature sera traitée en toute confidentialité.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken

- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

jobs.title: Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d) (Rohrvorrichter/in)
jobs.description:
Unsere Berufung ist die Planung, Herstellung, Lieferung, Montage und Inbetriebnahme von Dampfturbosätzen, mit denen wir den individuellen Kundenbedürfnissen vollumfänglich gerecht werden.

Wir kombinieren erstklassige Qualität mit effektiven und sicheren Prozessen und hinterfragen unser Denken und Handeln stets auf Nachhaltigkeit in Bezug auf unsere Produkte, die Umwelt sowie die Gesundheit und Entwicklung unserer Beschäftigten.

Als Arbeitgeber sind wir ein professionell agierender Mittelständler (mit derzeit ca.200 Mitarbeitern), der sich die Flexibilität und Handlungsschnelligkeit aus der Gründungszeit durch kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien beibehalten hat. In diesem Geist denken wir lösungsorientiert und pragmatisch, sind mutig und entscheidungsfreudig und können somit schnell und zielorientiert im Sinne des Kunden und der Mitarbeiter reagieren.

Da wir stetig wachsen, suchen wir als Verstärkung ab sofort eine(n)

Vorrichter/Rohrschlosser (m/w/d)

So passt du zu uns:

- Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dein Handeln gegenüber unseren Kunden und Kollegen.
- Du arbeitest gerne in einem Team, da du Spaß daran hast, vernetzt zu sein und über deinen Bereich hinaus zu denken.
- Dir ist eine gerade und direkte, aber auch respektvolle und anerkennende Kommunikation sehr wichtig.
- Du schätzt es, wenn ein Unternehmen nicht nur Loyalität von dir erwartet, sondern sich auch für seine Mitarbeiter einsetzt.
- Du bist authentisch und integer, lebst deine eigenen Wertvorstellungen und Überzeugungen und bringst dabei Ecken und Kanten mit.
- Du hast Spaß am Umgang mit internationalen Kunden, bist reisebereit und kannst Dich gut auf Deutsch und Englisch ausdrücken - vielleicht beherrscht Du sogar noch eine weitere Fremdsprache.
****
Das verantwortest du:
-  Du übernimmst bei der Montage unserer Dampfturbosätze die Vorrichtarbeiten für den Rohrleitungsbau.

Das erwarten wir von dir:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Rohrschlosser oder im Bereich Metallbau, Schweißtechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Rohrleitungsbau
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft und Flexibilität (80% Außendienst).
- Sicherer Umgang mit den üblichen schweißtechnischen Dokumenten, eigenständiges Arbeiten nach Planungsunterlagen/Isometrien.
- Führerschein Klasse B.
- Technisches Verständnis.

Das bieten wir dir:

-  30 Tage Urlaub/Jahr
- Gleitzeitmöglichkeit zum Abbau von Überstunden
- Mitarbeiterangebote über Corporate Benefit Programm
- Fahrradleasing als geldwerter Vorteil
- Zuschuss zu Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft (nach 2-jähriger Zugehörigkeit)
- Zuschuss zu Betrieblicher Altersvorsorge oder VWL
- Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Unfallversicherung (auch für private Unfälle)

Auf unserer Homepage kannst du dich direkt über das Bewerbungsformular bewerben:

jobs.description:
Ihre Chance für den nächsten Karriereschritt
Sind Sie bereit, den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere zu gehen und eine neue Herausforderung anzunehmen? Wir suchen Sie als Solutions Consultant mit Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen für ein weltweit führendes Suchmaschinenunternehmen. Werden Sie Teil eines dynamischen Teams in Sofia, das erstklassigen Kundenservice bietet und Nutzern hilft, das Beste aus ihren Produkten herauszuholen. Wir unterstützen Sie bei Ihrem Umzug nach Bulgarien!

Ihre Aufgaben

Kompetente Beratung und Support für unsere Produkte und Dienstleistungen mit Fokus auf höchste Kundenzufriedenheit

- Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Software, Ticketsystemen und weiteren Service-Tools, um individuelle Kundenbedürfnisse zu erfüllen
- Betreuung von Kunden über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, Chat)
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen innerhalb der vereinbarten Service-Level-Agreements (SLAs)
- Erreichen und Übertreffen von Leistungszielen wie Bearbeitungszeit, Erstlösungsquote und Kundenzufriedenheit
- Zusammenarbeit im Team zur Weitergabe von Best Practices und Mitgestaltung der Wissensdatenbank
- Teilnahme an regelmäßigen Schulungen und kontinuierliche Weiterbildung zu Produkten und Branchenentwicklungen

Ihr Profil

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke
- Fähigkeit, strukturierten Anleitungen und Prozessen zu folgen
- Hervorragende Zuhör- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten
- Hohe Lernbereitschaft und Anpassungsfähigkeit an neue Technologien und Prozesse
- Eigenmotivation und Leidenschaft für exzellenten Kundenservice

Das zeichnet Sie aus

- Kundenfokussiertes Denken mit dem Ziel, erstklassigen Service zu leisten
- Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu erklären
- Kreative Lösungsfindung bei auftretenden Herausforderungen
- Teamfähigkeit, Wissensaustausch und positive Mitarbeit im Team
- Gelassenheit und schnelle Auffassungsgabe auch unter Druck

Das Beste: Sie benötigen keine technische Vorbildung!
Wir suchen motivierte Persönlichkeiten, die bereit sind zu lernen und Freude daran haben, anderen zu helfen. Unser umfassendes Schulungsprogramm bereitet Sie optimal auf Ihre Aufgaben vor.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- Flexible Vertragsmodelle (befristet, Teilzeit möglich)
- Finanzielle Unterstützung bei Ihrem Umzug (z. B. Transport, Hotel, Miete, Unterstützung bei der Wohnungssuche)
- Vollständig bezahlte Schulungen
- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit attraktiven Karrierechancen
- Leistungsgerechte Vergütung
- Zusätzliche private Krankenversicherung
- Über 50 verschiedene Benefits und Services zur Auswahl
- Positives internationales Arbeitsumfeld
- Kontinuierliche Unterstützung und Weiterentwicklung
- Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprämien

Starten Sie Ihre Karriere in Sofia – wir wachsen gemeinsam!
Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Lernen, Teamwork und Ihr Wohlbefinden in den Mittelpunkt stellt.

Klingt das nach Ihrer Traumstelle? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt!

- Du bist fit in der Sport - Physiotherapie?

- Du behandelst gerne Leistungssportler/innen vom Freizeit-  bis Spitzensport?

dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Wir sind seit über 30 Jahren in Spanien und auf der schönen Kanareninsel im Bereich Sportmedizin, Wellness, Health und Kosmetik tätig und freuen uns auf Dich.

Komm ins Team und sei ein wichtiger Teil des Sportlichen Erfolges und der Erholung unserer Athleten
