jobs.title: Security Engineer - Incident Response
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast.

This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Incident Response

 - Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

 - Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken.

 - Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

 - Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation.


Investigation & Forensics

 - Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts.

 - Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents.

 - Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected.


IR Automation & Tooling

 - Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage.

 - Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible.

 - Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain.



Detection & Continuous Improvement

 - Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion.

 - Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment.

 - Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure.

 - Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking).

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads.

 - Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse).

 - Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes.

 - Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms.

 - Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers.

 - Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research.

 - Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

 - Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience.
   


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curiosity & initiative: Strong desire to understand attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and how they apply to real-world systems.
   

 - Speed & analytical rigor: Ability to quickly assess high-risk vulnerabilities with clear, evidence-based reasoning.
   

 - Collaboration: Comfort working across cross-functional teams spanning Security, SRE, Engineering, and Infrastructure.
   

 - Clear communication: Ability to explain findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels.
   

 - Ownership mindset: Takes initiative to drive investigations, improvements, and remediations to completion.
   

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying up to date on new vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and cloud-native security best practices.
   





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Mechanic, HGV Mechanic or Welder wanted for varied role in Glostrup
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced mechanic or welder who thrives in a varied working environment with a high degree of responsibility? Would you like to work in a small, dynamic team where there is a short path from idea to action? Then you may be the person we are looking for at our workshop in Glostrup.

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

We imagine that you:

  • Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

  • Have several years of experience from a similar position

  • Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

  • Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

  • Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

  • Work in a structured and independent manner

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible

What We Offer

We offer an exciting and varied position in an informal working environment with good colleagues and a friendly atmosphere. You will have opportunities for professional development and the freedom to influence your own working day.

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

The position is available as soon as possible, but we are happy to wait for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Er du SuperUsers' nye dataspecialist og -instruktør?
jobs.description:
Er du stærk inden for data, og har du lyst til at fordybe dig fagligt, arbejde med nye teknologier inden for data og AI og lære fra dig som kursusinstruktør? Så er du måske vores nye fuldtidskollega!

Vi søger en teknisk stærk og nysgerrig dataperson med et solidt fagligt fundament og lyst til løbende at udvide det. Særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python er centrale teknologier i rollen, suppleret af Power BI og SQL som vigtige dele af værktøjskassen. Dataområdet udvikler sig hurtigt i takt med AI, og du vil få mulighed for at arbejde med teknologier og løsninger i krydsfeltet mellem data, analytics og AI.

Undervisningserfaring er ikke et krav. Det er derimod vigtigt, at du har lyst til at formidle, forklare og gøre komplekse tekniske emner forståelige og anvendelige for andre.

Om SuperUsers A/S
SuperUsers er et danskejet IT-kursus- og konsulenthus, stiftet i 1984. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger, der brænder for kurser, læring og kompetenceudvikling inden for bl.a. data, AI, cloud, cybersikkerhed, softwareudvikling og infrastruktur. Vi er bl.a. officiel Microsoft Training Services Partner og samarbejder med en række af branchens førende teknologileverandører.

Du bliver en del af vores team af konsulenter og instruktører, måske Danmarks bedste, når det gælder teknisk undervisning på højt niveau. Fælles for os er, at vi går op i vores fag, følger udviklingen tæt og gerne deler vores viden med både kursister og hinanden.

Vi har afdelinger i både Hillerød og Aarhus. I Hillerød får du din daglige gang på Karlebogaard, en historisk landejendom, hvor vi hver dag byder kursister velkommen på kursus i nogle helt unikke rammer. Her bliver du en del af et fagligt og socialt miljø med ca. 20 kolleger.

Om stillingen som instruktør
Din primære opgave bliver at undervise og afholde tekniske kurser for IT- og datafolk. Du kommer til at arbejde med og undervise inden for vores dataområder og får rig mulighed for løbende at udvide med nye teknologier og fagområder. Vi lægger stor vægt på at følge udviklingen tæt, og du får derfor både tid og mulighed for faglig fordybelse, selvstudie, kurser og sparring med vores øvrige instruktører.

På sigt vil cirka halvdelen af din tid være undervisning. Den øvrige tid vil blandt andet gå med forberedelse, udvikling af kurser og labs, opdatering af undervisningsmateriale, faglig udvikling samt konsulent- og kundeopgaver afhængigt af aktuelle behov.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • Undervise inden for særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python, samt Power BI, SQL og relaterede dataområder.

  • Formidle data engineering, analyse og moderne dataplatforme på en jordnær og anvendelig måde.

  • Udvikle og opdatere kurser, øvelser og undervisningsmateriale, samt sparre med vores øvrige instruktører og konsulenter.

  • Holde dig fagligt opdateret og være med til at vurdere, hvilke nye teknologier vi skal arbejde med, herunder udviklingen inden for AI og samspillet mellem AI, data engineering og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Løse enkelte konsulentopgaver, når de opstår inden for dine fagområder.

  • Lejlighedsvis undervise eller deltage i aktiviteter på vores øvrige lokationer, typisk hver 1.-2. måned.


Din profil:

Vi ser gerne, at du har praktisk erfaring og viden inden for dataområdet, helst med én eller flere af emnerne, du skal undervise i. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét, men du skal have den tekniske forståelse og nysgerrighed, så du hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye områder.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har interesse for data engineering, datamodellering, analytics og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Har lyst til at formidle og lære fra dig, også hvis du ikke tidligere har undervist.

  • Er god til at formulere dig mundtligt og skriftligt, helst på både dansk og engelsk.

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i mindre teams.

  • Er nysgerrig, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine egne fagområder.


SuperUsers tilbyder:

  • Relevante certificeringer som en naturlig del af jobbet, bl.a. Microsoft Certified Trainer og Databricks-certificeringer, samt gode muligheder for kurser, faglig fordybelse og udvikling af dine specialistområder.

  • Stor autonomi, fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar samt et rart og socialt arbejdsmiljø på Karlebogaard.

  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med dygtige instruktører, konsulenter og ildsjæle, som gerne deler deres viden og sparrer med hinanden.

  • Mulighed for at præge vores eksisterende kurser, være med til at udvikle nye og gøre en forskel for andres faglige udvikling.


Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper Olsen på super@superusers.dk med emnet “Dataspecialist – Hillerød”.Vi holder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingen, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Vil du være en del af vores stærke pædagogteam i børnehaven i Schous Børnehus?
jobs.description:
Vi er netop i gang med en rivende faglig udvikling i vores børnehave – og nu mangler vi den sidste pædagog på holdet, der sammen med os vil være med til at løfte vores børnehave til næste niveau.

Måske er det dig?

Måske er du optaget af musik og fællessang.
Måske elsker du udeliv, natur og ture ud af huset.
Måske er du god til fortællinger, teater eller til at skabe fantasifulde legeuniverser.

Eller måske er din største styrke, at du møder børn med varme, nærvær og en særlig evne til at få alle med i fællesskabet.

Hos os er der plads til forskellige pædagogiske interesser og kompetencer – for vi tror på, at stærke børnefællesskaber skabes af voksne, der bringer deres faglighed og personlighed i spil.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:
Som pædagog i børnehaven bliver du en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt team, hvor du blandt andet vil:
  • Planlægge og deltage aktivt i børnenes lege, aktiviteter og hverdag
  • Understøtte børns sprog gennem leg, sang, fortælling, samtaler og fælles aktiviteter
  • Bidrage med dine egne interesser og pædagogiske idéer til aktiviteter og projekter i børnehaven
  • Støtte børn i at indgå i lege og fællesskaber
  • Samarbejde med forældre om børnenes trivsel, udvikling og hverdag

Vi søger en pædagog, der:
  • Er uddannet pædagog
  • Ikke kan lade være med at bringe sine interesser og kompetencer i spil i arbejdet med børn
  • Kan skabe trygge relationer til både børn, forældre og kolleger
  • Er nysgerrig på pædagogisk praksis og bidrager til faglige refleksioner og udvikling
  • Har blik for børns forskellige behov og deltagelsesmuligheder

Som person:
  • Møder du børn og forældre med nærvær, nysgerrighed og autenticitet
  • Har du ro, overblik og struktur
  • Bidrager du aktivt til fællesskabet med humor, engagement og initiativ
  • Er du fagligt reflekteret og har lyst til både at lære og dele viden med dine kolleger

Hvem er vi?
Schous Børnehus er en selvejende integreret daginstitution midt i Københavns Nordvestkvarter – tæt på både Utterslev Mose, byens liv og kulturtilbud.

Vi holder til i en tidligere sæbefabrik, hvor det stadig bobler af leg, nysgerrighed og livsglæde.

Hos os tror vi på, at gode relationer er fundamentet for udvikling – både for børn og voksne. Vi arbejder målrettet med sprog, fællesskaber og udviklende læringsmiljøer, og vi prioriterer tid til faglig refleksion og samarbejde i hverdagen.

I Schous Børnehus er det trygt at fejle og let at få idéer i spil. Hos os er det vigtigt, at vi lykkes sammen.

Vi tilbyder dig:
  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer i børnehaven
  • Tiltrædelse 1. december 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter
  • Et fagligt stærkt fællesskab med høje ambitioner på børnenes vegne
  • Løbende faglig opkvalificering
  • En grundig mentorordning for en tryg opstart
  • To årlige personalearrangementer og to temadage med overnatning
  • Gode fysiske rammer og aktiv brug af lokalområdet
  • En hverdag præget af arbejdsglæde, initiativ og gensidig støtte

Se vores video "Arbejdspladsen man ikke vil hjem fra" på YouTube og få et indblik i vores hverdag.

Interesseret?
Du er meget velkommen til at ringe eller kigge forbi til en rundvisning – vi fortæller gerne mere om vores børnehus.

Kontakt leder, Mia Kehlet på tlf. 3062 8104 .

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag/referencer til: leder@schousbornehus.dk.

jobs.title: Paid Social Specialist – bliv ekspert i én branche
jobs.description:
Hjælp top 1 % med at blive endnu rigere
Fuldtid · Fysisk på kontoret ved Vesterport, København · Start hurtigst muligt

På Vinduespudserskolen starter man typisk som elev, fordi man drømmer om mere frihed i sin hverdag.

Det er helt simpelt. Forestil dig, at vinduespudseren kommer ud til en kunde på det tidspunkt, der passer ham. Han pudser huset hele vejen rundt på 5 minutter, systemet sender automatisk en faktura på 399 kr. til kunden og navigerer ham videre til næste kunde på vejen.

Så kan man selv regne på det. Gør du det én gang om dagen, 22 dage om måneden, har du 8.778 kr. i omsætning. Gør du som de andre, bare 15 gange om dagen, omsætter du for 131.670 kr. om måneden. Og så er der selvfølgelig dem, der præsterer det dobbelte, og dem, der snart runder 1 mio. kr. om måneden (hvor deres ansatte udfører opgaven, ansatte de også får oplært på skolen)

Et opslag skal jo have en fængende overskrift, men for at forklare den: Modellen har været udgangspunktet for, at vi har hjulpet mange af vores elever til at blive blandt de 1 % rigeste i deres aldersgruppe. Typisk folk, der ikke passede ind i den traditionelle skole.

Kort sagt er det grundlaget for Vinduespudserskolen. Med systemer og intensiv træning, fra håndværket nede på skolen til hele forretningen, fx at sælge til højere priser og med hyppigere intervaller, optimerer vi for eleverne. Vi er et fuldtidsteam, der ikke laver andet end at støtte, udvikle og træne vores elever i det, de har brug for.

Når eleverne har lært at sælge gode priser, gode intervaller og mange naboer, hjælper vi dem også med at reinvestere en del i tiltag som Meta Ads. Det må dog aldrig være deres eneste kilde til nye kunder.

Det er her, du kommer ind

Malte står i dag for at køre annoncer for en lang række elever. De sidste 4 år har han ikke lavet andet end at skaffe de bedste kunder til vinduespudserfirmaer, så han har en stor specialviden på området. Nu er vi nået dertil, hvor vi gerne vil have en ekstra person med på teamet til at arbejde sammen med Malte.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med Meta Ads, som du kan vise frem. Google Ads er et plus, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du aldrig bliver helt tilfreds og hele tiden vil finde ud af, hvordan en kampagne kan blive bedre.

Du følger med i, hvad der sker med AI, og bruger det aktivt, fx med Make, til at automatisere rapportering og de opgaver, vi gør igen og igen. Ikke for at gøre tingene med hovedet under armen, men for at frigive tid, så vi kan bruge den på det, der gør en forskel for eleverne: at forstå dem, tale med dem og give dem et bedre og mere personligt produkt.

Du kommer til at holde møder med eleverne og være med på hele funnelen, fra annonce til hjemmeside. Hjemmesiderne udliciterer vi i dag, men dem vil vi gerne lave selv fremover. Og så skal du have lyst til at blive rigtig dygtig til ét område.

Opfylder du ikke alle punkter, men kan du genkende dig selv i det meste, så søg alligevel.

Hvem du er

Du starter med en intensiv oplæring. Vi forestiller os, at du tager ansvar for det, du har lovet en elev, og leverer det. Du er punktlig med dine aftaler og forventer det samme af andre. Og du kan lide at arbejde i et team.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst team, der gerne vil have, at du udvikler dig sammen med os. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på fuldtid, og du arbejder fysisk fra vores kontor ved Vesterport i København. Vi vil gerne have dig med hurtigst muligt.

Sådan søger du

Før du søger, så gå ind på Vinduespudserskolens YouTube og få et indtryk af, hvilken type virksomhed vi er.

Send derefter en kort ansøgning til job@vinduespudserskolen.dk med emnet "Paid Social – dit navn". Fortæl os, hvorfor du mener, du er den rette til jobbet.

jobs.title: Welders, Offshore; Denmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
  • Assisting the mechanical team if needed
  • Helping out the other teams when necessary

Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

  • Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
  • Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
  • Availability to pass site tests
  • Preferably have offshore experience


Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.title: Area Manager – Main Component Exchanges (f/m/d); Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus, Germany , DE - Bremen, DE - Hamburg, DE - Emden
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced leader with a strong track record in offshore wind operations, service delivery, or project execution? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where safety, customer focus, and operational excellence go hand in hand? Then we look forward to your application as Area Manager (f/m/d) for Main Component Exchanges!

Your position
In your new position as Area Manager (f/m/d) for the Main Component Exchanges, you will lead the regional delivery of our offshore MCE business across Northern & Central Europe or the UK. You will be accountable for regional performance and play a key role in ensuring the successful execution of complex offshore campaigns.

The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel regularly depending on your main place of work. The projects are typically short- and long-term service contracts for our clients in Northern and Central Europe as well as the UK.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As Area Manager (f/m/d), you will be responsible for the overall performance of your region and ensure that customer commitments are delivered safely, efficiently, and predictably. You will provide leadership across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations while maintaining strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders. The role combines strategic oversight with operational leadership and serves as the primary escalation point within the region.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Leading regional project and operational delivery performance
  • Ensuring successful delivery of customer commitments regarding safety, quality, schedule, and cost
  • Prioritizing resources and resolving cross-project conflicts
  • Managing customer, operational, and project escalations
  • Supporting strategic workload and capability planning
  • Driving collaboration across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations
  • Ensuring implementation of the MCE operating model across the region
  • Supporting Sales & Business Development through customer, market and operational expertise


Your profile & qualifications
We are looking for an experienced and communicative Area Manager (f/m/d) who is passionate about Main Component Exchanges within Offshore Wind and wants to take ownership. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline
  • Proven leadership experience in offshore wind, marine operations, energy services, or a comparable industry
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, operations, and customer management
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and decision-making skills
  • A strong HSEQ mindset and commitment to safe execution
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken


Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. jobs.title: Specialarbejder/maskinfører til Miljøcenter i Kolding
jobs.description:
Meldgaard har i mange år sorteret og håndteret affald, jord og genbrugsprodukter. I dag har vi miljøcentre/modtageanlæg i bl.a. Kolding, Klintholm, Herning og posesortering i Aalborg. Afdelingerne har været igennem en kraftig udvikling med masser af nye aktiviteter i en spændende branche.

Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have/park-affald, pap/papir og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 

Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Jobbet

Vi søger en specialarbejder til drift af vores helt nye presse på vores miljøcenter i Kolding. 
Du vil komme til at beskæftige dig med at overvåge pressen og kørsel af maskiner (gummiged, materialehåndteringsmaskine og gaffeltruck). Derudover vil du stå for sortering samt drift og vedligeholdelse af pladsen, pressen, maskiner samt alle forefaldende opgaver. Disse opgaver løses i samarbejde med driftslederen samt dine kommende kollegaer. 

Stillingen er på 37 timer, og arbejdstiden vil ligge mellem kl. 07.00 – 16.00.

Du vil blive en del af et lille team, hvor vi er hurtige til at træffe beslutninger og få opgaverne løst.

Du har interesse og god forståelse for teknik samt maskiner og deres funktion. Dine hænder er skruet godt på, og du har erfaring eller interesse for kørsel af ballepresse, entreprenør- eller landbrugsmaskiner. Du elsker nye udfordringer, er omstillingsparat og vil gerne lære nyt. Du tager ejerskab i dit job og brænder for at gøre en forskel. 

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du: 
  • Er maskinfører
  • Kendskab til affaldssortering er en fordel
  • Har kørekort kategori B 
  • Fordel hvis du har erfaring med ballepresse
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig er en god teamplayer
  • Har godt humør
  • Har truckcertifikat
  • Er fleksibel

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje.

jobs.title: HSEQ Manager - Balance of Plant; Location: DK - Esbjerg, UK - Grimsby
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HSEQ professional with a passion for renewable energy and safe project delivery? Do you want to help shape safe, compliant and efficient Balance of Plant projects? Join us and become an energy pioneer in the industry!

Your position

In your new position as HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be a key member of our Renewables HSEQ function, supporting safe and compliant Balance of Plant project delivery across offshore wind projects. You will provide first-line HSEQ leadership, guide and support HSEQ Advisors, and work closely with Project Managers, the Head of BoP and operational teams to ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded from tender and pre-project preparation through to execution, reporting and lessons learned.

We are not just looking for someone who is technically qualified and experienced; we are looking for someone who shares our view of safety.

As part of the recruitment process, we will discuss how you see New View safety concepts, including Safety I and Safety II, HOP, and Safety Differently, working together to deliver safe outcomes. We will also explore how you believe the right information can be provided to the right people, whether that is controls for frontline workers, data for support teams, or due diligence information for leadership teams. In addition, we will discuss your perspective on the role of the HSEQ team in enabling learning, supporting operations and strengthening safe delivery.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient project delivery from sales and pre-project kick-off preparation through to project execution, operational learning, customer support and knowledge sharing.

  • Preparing and managing project-specific HSEQ documentation, including Project HSEQ Plans, Construction Phase Plans, emergency response plans, bridging documents, RAMS, LOTO input and supporting reference documents.

  • Supporting sales, tenders and project planning by reviewing contracts, identifying HSEQ deliverables and ensuring adequate costs and resources are planned for required HSEQ activities.

  • Preparing and contributing to kick-off meetings, project meetings and HSEQ presentations, ensuring relevant safety rules, evacuation arrangements, reporting requirements, initiatives, safety alerts and lessons learned are communicated.

  • Monitoring project execution, including completion of emergency response drill plans, weather day training plans, site visit quality, Synergy use, EFA kit compliance, action follow-up and investigation quality.

  • Leading or supporting significant investigations, ensuring clear descriptions, root causes, contributing factors, control measures and corrective and preventative actions are identified, tracked and closed effectively.

  • Maintaining professional relationships with client representatives, supporting positive safety culture, encouraging reporting and learning, and facilitating end-of-project lessons learned.



Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured, proactive and collaborative HSEQ professional who is passionate about offshore renewable energy and wants to leave their mark on safe project execution. You take ownership of HSEQ standards, are confident engaging with operational and project stakeholders, and can balance operational essentials with learning-focused activities that improve safety outcomes.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Solid HSEQ experience within offshore wind, marine, construction, renewables or other project-based operational environments.

  • Experience preparing, reviewing and maintaining HSEQ documentation such as RAMS, HSEQ plans, emergency response plans, drill plans, investigation reports and lessons learned material.

  • Confidence supporting tenders, contract reviews, project kick-off activities and HSEQ input to operational planning.

  • Experience guiding, supporting or leading HSEQ Advisors or site-based HSEQ personnel.

  • Strong investigation, reporting and follow-up skills, with the ability to identify trends, communicate areas of concern and drive actions through to completion.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work closely with Project Managers, clients, offshore teams and senior HSEQ leadership.



Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we are energy pioneers - working together to create a sustainable energy future through our innovative solutions and services. With us, you will be part of a community of over 2,000 dedicated people who are driving change and making a real difference in meeting the world's growing energy demand.

You will experience an international, inclusive and inspiring workplace where diversity, collaboration and a healthy work-life balance are not just buzzwords but integrated values that drive our success. We offer flexible working arrangements, on-site fitness facilities, and tasty, organic food in our canteen that will have your taste buds singing. Plus, we like to have fun along the way with lots of fun social activities!

Your place of work can be based either in the UK or Denmark, with regular collaboration across our international teams. The position is full-time, and you can expect travel to project and offshore locations as required, including site visits in line with project needs.

Become an energy pioneer

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Let’s drive change together. Apply today to leave your mark on the global energy industry.

We cannot wait to hear from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Udskolingslærer søges til Magleblik Skole
jobs.description:
HDS 

Magleblik Skole er i vækst – både på almen- og specialområdet – og søger derfor dygtige, relationsstærke og fagligt engagerede lærere til vores udskoling (6.-9. årgang).

Vi søger en lærer med kompetencer inden for HDS – gerne suppleret med engelsk eller tysk. Der er mulighed for både fuldtids- og deltidsansættelse.

Vi leder efter lærere, der brænder for at skabe stærke læringsfællesskaber, inspirerende undervisning og gode relationer til eleverne. Trives du i et tæt teamsamarbejde og ser mulighederne i en aktiv og praksisnær undervisning, kan Magleblik Skole være det rette sted for dig.

Om Magleblik Skole

På Magleblik Skole tror vi på, at alle børn kan lykkes. Vi ved også, at nogle elever skal arbejde hårdere, have mere støtte og møde flere forventninger end andre for at nå dertil.

Derfor søger vi en lærer, der brænder for både faglighed og relationer. En lærer, som insisterer på, at elevernes baggrund ikke skal afgøre deres muligheder i livet, og som vil være med til at bryde den sociale arv gennem stærk undervisning, tydelige fællesskaber og høje forventninger til alle.

Hos os bliver du en del af en skole, hvor vi arbejder målrettet for at løfte elevernes faglige niveau og trivsel. Vi er ambitiøse på elevernes vegne, fordi vi ved, at vores arbejde gør en forskel.

Magleblik Skole er en udviklingsorienteret skole med fokus på aktiv, engagerende og praksisnær læring. Vi vægter stærke relationer, tydelig klasseledelse og et tæt professionelt samarbejde højt.

Vores børnesyn er fundamentet for alt, hvad vi gør:

Børn kan være i problemer – men de er aldrig problemet.

Vi arbejder målrettet med læringsmiljøer, trivsel og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle elever. Samtidig er vi stolte af vores høje trivselsmålinger blandt både elever og medarbejdere.

De seneste år har vi blandt andet arbejdet med fagfornyelsens prøvehandlinger, udviklet og implementeret vores egen sprog- og læsestrategi og styrket matematikundervisningen gennem vejledere og fagudvalg. Vi udvikler os sammen – og vi forventer, at nye kolleger har lyst til at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling.

  • indgå aktivt i teamarbejde omkring elevernes faglige og sociale udvikling
  • være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen med stærke relationskompetencer
  • inddrage elevernes perspektiver i undervisningen
  • arbejde praksisnært og skabe sammenhæng mellem teori og virkelighed gennem varierede undervisningsformer
Vi forventer, at du
  • er uddannet lærer
  • har lyst til at arbejde med elever i udskolingen (6.-9. klasse)
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for elever med forskellige forudsætninger og behov
  • kan skabe trygge og udviklende undervisningsmiljøer
  • arbejder relationelt, anerkendende og professionelt
  • har fokus på trivsel, læring og tydelig klasseledelse
  • er fagligt nysgerrig, reflekterende og ambitiøs
  • trives i et forpligtende samarbejde og tager medansvar for fællesskabet
  • ser elevperspektivet som en vigtig del af udviklingen af undervisningen
Hos os får du

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • tæt teamsamarbejde
  • fokus på både elev- og medarbejdertrivsel
  • faglig sparring og videndeling
  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • et rummeligt, humoristisk og imødekommende lærerværelse

Gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • et åbent og respektfuldt arbejdsmiljø præget af engagement og udvikling
  • mulighed for faglig og pædagogisk udvikling
  • gode rammer for bevægelse og praktisk undervisning
  • mulighed for deltagelse i Halsnæs i Bevægelse (HIB)

Et stærkt støtteapparat

  • adgang til specialpædagogisk konsulent, forebyggelseskonsulent, PPR og mellemformskonsulenter
  • tæt samarbejde om undervisningsmiljø og struktur
  • et nærværende og tilgængeligt ledelsesteam
Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker efter gældende overenskomst. Grundløn for laveste grundlønstrin er 39.293,85 kr./md. ekskl. pension. Derudover kan der aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest inden ansættelse.

Kontakt

Ansøgningsfrist: 25. oktober 2026.

jobs.title: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

  • Overall organization of the kitchen

  • Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

  • Staff scheduling

  • General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

  • Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

  • Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

  • Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

  • Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

Dertil vil det være et plus med fleksibilitet ved ferie og sygdom. Vi er et punktligt team, der arbejder med faste deadlines som overholdes. Vi ansætter i henhold til industriens overenskomst og stillingen er timelønnet. Desuden vil stillingen kræve, at du potentielt skal vaccineres ved ansættelse.

Kvalifikationer

Dine faglige kompetencer

  • Du har et gyldigt kørekort (B)

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

Dine personlige kompetencer

  • Du trives i en travl hverdag, hvor der sættes pris på effektivitet og præcision

  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner og en fleksibel indstilling til tingene

  • Du er positiv, ansvarsfuld og udviser engagement

  • Du er mødestabil og robust. 

Yderligere oplysninger

Arbejdstid
Stillingen er ca. 12 timer om ugen. Det er mandag og tirsdag typisk ligger arbejdstiden mellem kl. 11:30 – færdig (19:00). Der kan forekomme flere dage.

Primært i firmabilen og på landevejen. 

Tiltrædelse
Snarest mulig efter aftale

Ansøgning
Du søger stillingen online ved at klikke på "Søg jobbet". Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter så snart, den rette kandidat er fundet og vi opfordrer derfor til, at du sender dit CV og evt. relevante bilag hurtigst muligt. Under ”Besked til ansættelsesteamet” modtager vi meget gerne en kort motivation for din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Disponent Sabina Nørgaard på Sabina.Norgaard@etn.eurofins.com.

Du kan læse mere om Eurofins på www.eurofins.dk.

I forbindelse med rekrutteringen vil du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen!

#Testing for life

Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier. 

På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 65.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 57 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.

I 2025 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 7,296 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år.

jobs.description:
Who Should Apply

 

We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit:

  • Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design.

  • Full-Stack & Web Developers working with modern front-end or back-end frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, etc.).

  • Backend & Systems Developers experienced in languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust, or Python.

  • DevOps & Database Engineers familiar with API design, SQL/NoSQL databases, or scripting.

 

Role & Responsibilities

As an AI Code Trainer, you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains.

  • Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices.

  • Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts.

  • Test Design: Build unit tests and edge-case scenarios to evaluate model accuracy and expose edge-case failures.

Requirements

Description des tâches:

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

Play a key role in the improvement and innovation of IT solutions within a dynamic agile team delivering high-quality services across key data domains. Contribute to major European and national initiatives, including HDAB2-LU, supporting the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and enabling secure, compliant, and efficient access to health data.
Support the delivery of strategic national and European initiatives focused on secure data sharing, health and research data ecosystems, and trustworthy AI adoption. Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, compliant, and impactful digital solutions in a complex multi-stakeholder environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently design, implement, deliver and maintain applications and platform services, integrating new solutions with LNDS's existing data-centric infrastructures. You will take ownership of defined technical areas, translating requirements into reliable, secure and maintainable solutions within agreed architectural and organisational standards. You will actively identify and deliver opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation, focusing on:

• Automating the software development lifecycle.
• Improving internal data flows, tooling and platform capabilities.
• Developing and supporting technical environments for data processing, analytics and AI-related experimentation.

You will be part of the Technology team, working closely with data specialists, AI experts and governance teams across different projects. You will contribute to high-impact European initiatives in AI, data governance and digital public infrastructure, exercising sound judgment about when to act independently, seek specialist input or escalate risks.

What you will do

Who you are

• MSc in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing
• 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in programming, deployment, and maintenance of applications
• Experience taking a feature, service or application from requirements through implementation, deployment and ongoing support
• Experience in data-related or research-oriented environments is considered an asset

Technical competencies

• Proficiency in Python or Node.js, with the ability to independently develop, test and maintain production software. Other languages are considered a plus
• Solid knowledge of backend development, including API design, services, integrations and error handling
• Frontend experience with React and Next.js is considered an asset
• Practical experience building, running and troubleshooting containerised applications using Docker or Podman
• Working knowledge of authentication and identity technologies, with experience integrating applications using relevant protocols or solutions such as OIDC, SAML, LDAP/AD or Keycloak
• Solid knowledge of SQL databases, including data modelling and query development; working knowledge of NoSQL technologies
• Working knowledge of cloud environments and application deployment, configuration and monitoring
• Practical experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
• Confidence working independently in Linux and Git-based development environments
• Ability to assess technical trade-offs involving maintainability, reliability, performance, security and delivery effort

Professional competencies

• Demonstrated ownership and accountability for the quality, delivery and ongoing operation of assigned solutions
• Ability to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, while recognising when alignment, specialist input or escalation is needed
• Analytical, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to break down moderately complex problems and resolve incomplete or ambiguous requirements
• Practical commitment to security and privacy by design
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholder
• Ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural environments
• Proactive approach to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback
• Ability to manage priorities and adapt to evolving requirements in projects with long-term impact
• Commitment to continued learning and the practical application of relevant technologies
• Cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness
• Fluent in English

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character. Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values. We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.

Une structure specialisee dans la restauration evenementielle recherche un(e) commis de cuisine passionne(e), consciencieux(se) et professionnel(le) pour rejoindre ses equipes sur les salons a Eurexpo Lyon.

Ici, pas de routine ni de carte figee : tu travailleras directement sur les differents salons, dans des restaurants fixes ou ephemeres installes au coeur d'Eurexpo. Chaque evenement est different, avec son propre univers, son organisation et son rythme. Un jour, tu peux etre sur Equita, quelques semaines plus tard sur Epoqu'auto, puis participer a l'un des temps forts de la saison avec le SIRHA.

La saison demarre a partir de fin octobre et se poursuit jusqu'a fin janvier, avec de nombreuses prestations au fil des salons. L'objectif : proposer une cuisine de qualite dans un environnement dynamique, ou il faut savoir s'adapter et surtout aimer le travail en equipe.

Tu es passionne(e) par la cuisine, tu aimes le travail bien fait et tu as envie d'apprendre et de progresser dans un environnement professionnel. Tu es serieux(se), volontaire, organise(e) et tu sais donner un coup de main la ou l'equipe en a besoin. Si tu es consciencieux(se), professionnel(le) et que l'evenementiel te plait, alors go !

Le poste est base a Eurexpo Lyon, avec des horaires qui varient en fonction des salons et des prestations. La remuneration est comprise entre 12,31 EUR et 13 EUR brut de l'heure, selon ton experience et ton autonomie.

Quels avantages as-tu de travailler pour TEMPORIS?
- Du plus sur ton salaire: 10% d'IFM + 10% de Conges payes
- Acces a notre plateforme de dematerialisation pour la signature electronique des contrats et la reception des bulletins de paie = creation de ton espace personnel
- Acces au CE des la 1ere heure
- Acces au FASTT: aide au logement, location de voiture, garde d'enfantsAcces a la mutuelle "Interimaires Sante" des la premiere heure.
- Possibilite d'etre forme(e) pour monter en competences sur un metier

Des salons differents, des equipes professionnelles et une saison bien remplie : si tu veux apprendre, cuisiner et evoluer dans un environnement qui bouge, on a envie de te rencontrer.

jobs.title: Conseiller-ère Services et Expériences Client (H/F) - CDI - Temps complet
jobs.description:
Chez Decathlon, notre passion du commerce et de la relation client est aussi forte que celle du sport. Ici, on ne se contente pas d'encaisser un achat : on crée des expériences, on accueille avec le sourire, on fidélise avec sincérité. Chez Decathlon, nous recrutons avant tout des personnalités. Ta mission : faire de chaque moment avec nos clients une expérience fluide, agréable et mémorable - du premier "bonjour" jusqu'à la dernière transaction.Ton quotidien, ce sera :Accueillir chaque client comme un invité de marque : en magasin ou à distance, tu proposes des solutions claires, pratiques et personnalisées (retours, location, seconde vie, financement.).Offrir une expérience de paiement simple, rapide et adaptée à chaque situation (caisse classique, mobile, self check-out.).Gérer les commandes en ligne (click & collect, ship from store.) avec efficacité, traçabilité et convivialité lors du retrait.Contribuer à la performance omnicanale du magasin, en fluidifiant les parcours client et en traitant les avis pour faire progresser l'expérience globale.Vendre avec le cœur, en orientant vers le bon produit ou service, même si c'est en ligne ou en stock ailleurs - parce qu'un client bien conseillé est un client heureux.
Chez Decathlon, tu n'es jamais "juste en caisse" : tu es un véritable créateur-rice de lien et d'émotion, un maillon essentiel de notre réussite collective.

Vous êtes.

jobs.title: Directeur Régional Hôtellerie (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels, développer le business et faire rayonner la destination Lille.

Un cluster hôtelier ne se développe pas uniquement grâce à la force de ses marques.


Il grandit grâce à une stratégie commerciale claire, des équipes engagées, une lecture fine du marché et une capacité à transformer chaque opportunité en performance.


Au sein de WiZiU, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Directeur Commercial Lille NB/F/H pour piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels multi enseignes , développer directement l'activité sur le marché lillois et accompagner les équipes dans leurs ambitions commerciales Ce que tu vas faire (et faire vivre au quotidien)

Tu définis et pilotes la stratégie commerciale du cluster en tenant compte des différents segments de marché, de la saisonnalité et des spécificités de chaque enseigne.


Tu contribues à la construction budgétaire et au suivi des projections de chiffre d'affaires, tout en accompagnant les évolutions stratégiques du portefeuille.


Tu restes également très présent(e) sur le terrain : prospection, rendez-vous clients, négociation, closing et développement d'un portefeuille Corporate, MICE et Groupes sur la place lilloise.


Tu pilotes directement le Group Desk , la Responsable Coordination Événementielle et l' Attachée Commerciale , et travailles en coordination étroite avec les Sales Manager/Commerciaux externes.


Tu fixes les priorités, accompagnes la performance de l'équipe et t'assures de la qualité du suivi commercial, des délais de réponse et de la conversion des opportunités.


Tu travailles au quotidien avec le Revenue Management pour partager le pipeline, arbitrer les opportunités et aligner stratégie commerciale et optimisation du revenu. Tu collabores également directement avec le Marketing pour activer les bons leviers sur le F&B, la visibilité digitale et les campagnes B2B.


Enfin, tu représentes WiZiU et ses hôtels auprès de l'écosystème économique et touristique lillois : acteurs institutionnels, réseaux d'entreprises, organisations professionnelles et partenaires de la destination Toi, tu es.

Tu as une expérience confirmée en direction commerciale hôtelière , idéalement sur un environnement multi-sites ou multi-marques.


Tu es avant tout un(e) commercial(e) de terrain : tu aimes prospecter, négocier, développer un réseau et closer.


Tu sais aussi prendre de la hauteur, construire une stratégie et accompagner une équipe dans sa performance.


Tu maîtrises les enjeux MICE, Groupes et Corporate , tu comprends les logiques de Revenue Management et tu sais travailler de manière fluide avec les équipes Marketing.


Tu es autonome, structuré(e), orienté(e) résultats et capable de passer naturellement d'un sujet stratégique à une problématique très opérationnelle.


Tu es à l'aise en anglais et tu as envie de prendre une place active dans l'écosystème économique lillois Pourquoi nous rejoindre.

Pour prendre la responsabilité commerciale d'un cluster de 8 hôtels aux enseignes fortes et complémentaires Pour occuper un rôle qui combine réellement stratégie, management et vente directe Pour travailler au cœur d'un environnement en transformation, avec des projets de repositionnement et d'évolution de marques.


Pour collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes Commerciales, Revenue, Marketing, Direction et Opérationnelles du Groupe.


Et surtout, pour avoir un impact direct sur le développement de WiZiU et de ses hôtels sur la place lilloise Tes avantages

- Bénéficiez d'une mutuelle prise en charge à 100 Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 60 Profitez du bénéfice des jours fériés dès 6 mois d'ancienneté chez WiZiU.
- Recevez une prime WiZconnect grâce à vos recommandations.
- Recevez la prime WiZtrust pour récompenser votre fidélité.
- Profitez de possibilités d'évolution au sein du Groupe.
- Bénéficiez du programme WiZdiscount avec des remises exclusives dans les hôtels, restaurants et SPA du Groupe WiZiU.


Chez WiZiU, chaque stratégie, chaque relation client et chaque opportunité transformée participent au développement de nos hôtels.


Derrière la performance d'un cluster, il y a aussi un(e) Directeur Commercial(e) capable de donner une direction, d'embarquer les équipes et de rester connecté(e) au terrain Salaire : 65 à 70K€ annuel + 15% variable.


Poste Cadre basé à Lille.

Dostavljena dokumentacija neće se vraćati. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadržava sve podatke, kontakt podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Sve pristigle prijave biti će zaštićene od pristupa neovlaštenih osoba te pohranjene na sigurno mjesto i čuvane u skladu s uvjetima i rokovima predviđenim zakonskim propisima, aktima i odluka voditelja obrade.

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola.

Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu.

Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanja osoba s invaliditetom (NN157/13,152/14,39/18,32/20)https://www.zakon.hr/z/493/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-i-zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom, dužan/a se u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na prednost prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/a je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na prednost prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanja osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na natječaj dužan/a je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete obavit će se intervjui te po potrebi provesti dodatno testiranje u svrhu provjere znanja, vještina i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta za koje se kandidati/kinje primaju u radni odnos.

Kandidat/kinja koji/a se u prijavi poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po posebnom zakonu, Centar neće dati prednost pri zapošljavanju ukoliko se po provedenom dodatnom testiranju utvrdi da se kandidat/kinja ne preporuča ili da se izrazito ne preporuča.

Prijave na natječaj se s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja mogu predati preporučenom ili običnom pošiljkom, na adresu: Centar za pružanje usluga u zajednici - Centar za starije osobe Općine Medulin, Centar 223, Medulin, P.P. 20 s naznakom: „Natječaj za zapošljavanje s navođenjem radnog mjesta za koje se kandidat prijavljuje - ne otvaraj“.

Natječaj je objavljen putem Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na mrežnoj stranici Centra te u Narodnim novinama dana 30.9.2026. godine.

Rok za podnošenje prijava na natječaj je 8 dana od objave u Narodnim novinama a krajnji rok prijave je 8.10.2026. godine.

O terminima intervjua te o rezultatima natječaja kandidati/kinje bit će obaviješteni putem mrežne stranice Centra za starije osobe Općine Medulin – https://centar-medulin.hr/objave
