jobs.title: Forskningsprojekt Arven i Landskabet
jobs.description:
Museum Odense søger en postdoc til en etårig stilling i forskningsprojektet Arven i Landskabet.

Forskningsprojektet

Det danske landskab står over for nogle af de største forandringer i nyere tid. Med Den Grønne Trepart og en række andre natur-, klima- og miljøtiltag skal store arealer i de kommende år ændre anvendelse. Landbrug, natur, biodiversitet, klima og lokale interesser skal finde nye balancer. Men det er ikke første gang, det danske landskab gennemgår en grundlæggende omstilling.

Arven i Landskabet undersøger det store brud i det danske landskabs udvikling ca. 1780-1914. I løbet af denne periode blev et varieret og mange steder ekstensivt udnyttet kulturlandskab forandret til et stadig mere intensivt landbrugslandskab. Gennem analyser af blandt andet historiske kort, nationale data og lokale kilder undersøger projektet, hvad der drev forandringerne, hvordan de udspillede sig forskelligt fra sted til sted, og hvilken betydning landskabets fysiske rammer, teknologiske muligheder, økonomiske interesser og menneskers valg havde.

Projektet stopper imidlertid ikke i 1914. Et centralt mål er at bringe den historiske viden i spil i den aktuelle grønne omstilling. Hvad kan tidligere tiders gennemgribende landskabsforandringer fortælle os om de processer, konflikter og muligheder, der præger omstillingen i dag? Og hvordan kan et langt historisk perspektiv kvalificere vores forståelse af de valg, der nu træffes om fremtidens landskab?

Projektet er støttet af Augustinus Fonden 2026-2029 og placeret på Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum. Din arbejdsplads bliver på Museum Odense. Læs mere på https://museumodense.dk/forskningsartikler/arven-i-landskabet/.

Stillingen

Som postdoc får du en central rolle i den del af Arven i Landskabet, der forbinder projektets historiske undersøgelser med de landskabsforandringer, der finder sted i Danmark netop nu.

En væsentlig opgave bliver at undersøge, hvordan nutidens landmænd, lodsejere og andre lokale aktører oplever og forholder sig til den grønne omstilling og til konkrete forandringer i det landskab, de lever og arbejder i. Det gælder blandt andet processer og naturprojekter knyttet til Den Grønne Trepart. Gennem kvalitative interviews og, hvor det er relevant, surveys og andre analyser skal du undersøge aktørernes perspektiver, handlemuligheder og interesser samt de muligheder og konflikter, der opstår, når hensyn til landbrugsproduktion, klima, biodiversitet, natur og lokalsamfund mødes.

Undersøgelserne skal sættes i relation til projektets historiske forskning. Du kommer dermed til at arbejde med spørgsmål som: Hvordan gennemføres store landskabsforandringer lokalt? Hvad får mennesker til at medvirke til, modsætte sig eller forsøge at påvirke dem? Hvilken betydning har erfaringer, ejerskab, økonomi, natursyn og tilknytning til landskabet? Og hvad kan erfaringerne fra tidligere perioder med omfattende landskabsforandringer bidrage med til de beslutninger, vi træffer i dag?

Opgaven har således en klar ramme, men der er samtidig betydeligt forskningsmæssigt råderum. Afhængigt af din faglige profil og dine interesser får du mulighed for at præge undersøgelsens forskningsspørgsmål, teoretiske perspektiv, metode og konkrete empiriske fokus inden for projektets overordnede problemstillinger.

Du bliver en del af en tværfaglig forskningsgruppe på tværs af Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum og vil arbejde tæt sammen med projektets øvrige forskere. Stillingen indebærer både selvstændigt forskningsarbejde og deltagelse i projektets fælles aktiviteter. Du forventes blandt andet at bidrage til projektets dataindsamling og analyser, videnskabelige publikationer, den afsluttende antologi og et fagligt symposium samt til formidling af forskningen til en bredere offentlighed og den aktuelle debat om fremtidens landskab.

Kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har en ph.d.-grad eller tilsvarende inden for f.eks. etnologi, antropologi, historie eller tilsvarende relevante fag.
  • Har erfaring med interviews til forskningsundersøgelser.
  • Har interesse for landskabsforskning og -forvaltning.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Har kørekort B, da der kan forventes kørsel i arbejdstiden. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Et tværfagligt og spændende forskningsmiljø, heriblandt fire andre forskere ved Arven i Landskabet i Odense.
  • Deltagelse i den større tværfaglige projektgruppe med forskere på Aarhus Universitet, Det Grønne Museum og Museum Odense (heriblandt Den Fynske Landsby).
  • En kombination af klart definerede projektopgaver og forskningsmæssigt råderum til at udvikle egne spørgsmål og analyser inden for projektets ramme.

Ansøgning og ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

  • En motiveret ansøgning (maks. 2 sider), hvor du redegør for:
    • din motivation for at søge stillingen
    • dine kvalifikationer i forhold til opslaget
    • en kort beskrivelse af, hvordan du vil tilgå projektet forskningsmæssigt
  • CV (maks. 2 sider)
  • En kopi af kandidatbevis og evt. ph.d.-bevis
  • Publikationsliste med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, som ønskes taget i betragtning ved bedømmelsen
  • Maksimalt 2 vedhæftede publikationer til bedømmelse.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. nov. 2026

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende forhandlingsberettigede overenskomst. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i 12 måneder. Det primære arbejdssted er Forskningscenter CENTRUM ved Museum Odense og det forventes, at du som udgangspunkt er til stede på museet i arbejdstiden. Der vil dog forekomme feltarbejde, seminarer og projektmøder andre steder.

jobs.title: Experienced Data Engineer Consultant
jobs.description:
Experienced Data Engineer Consultant

  • Kampmannsgade 2, 1604 København, Denmark

  • Full-time

  • Contract type: Permanent contract

Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. 

  • Contract: Full-time 

  • Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

  • Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

  • Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. 

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

  • Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. 

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. 

  • Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

  • A relevant degree.

  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.

  • Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:

  • Migrated Novo's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

  • Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

  • Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

jobs.title: Orthoptistes : un CDI à Sedan H/F Debutant ok !
jobs.description:
DN8 Solutions LTD recrute un orthoptiste (H/F) pour exercer au sein d'un cabinet ophtalmologique situé à Sedan. Ce poste en contrat à durée indéterminée constitue une opportunité d'intégrer une structure médicale à taille humaine, où vous jouerez un rôle central dans la prise en charge des patients aux côtés des médecins ophtalmologistes.
Vous assurez l'ensemble des actes orthoptiques dans le cadre de consultations organisées et encadrées.
Vos missions portent principalement sur le bilan visuel, le dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation, ainsi que sur la rééducation orthoptique des patients de tous âges.
Vous contribuez activement à la fluidité des consultations en réalisant les examens complémentaires nécessaires à l'établissement du diagnostic médical.
Le poste est ouvert aux candidats débutants. Vous bénéficiez d'un encadrement adapté à votre niveau d'expérience et d'une montée en compétences progressive dans un environnement clinique structuré. Cette configuration est particulièrement favorable pour les orthoptistes souhaitant consolider leur pratique clinique en sortie de formation.
Vous évoluez dans un cadre de travail stable, avec des horaires définis permettant un équilibre satisfaisant entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle. Les équipements techniques mis à disposition sont adaptés aux exigences de la pratique orthoptique contemporaine, incluant les outils de réfractométrie, de périmétrie et d'imagerie fonctionnelle.
Ce poste représente une opportunité concrète de développer votre expertise clinique au sein d'une équipe médicale investie dans la qualité des soins apportés à ses patients.
Profil recherché:
Titulaire du Certificat de Capacité d'Orthoptiste (CCO), vous êtes débutant(e) ou disposez d'une première expérience en cabinet ophtalmologique ou en structure de soins. Les candidatures en sortie de formation sont les bienvenues.
- Maîtrise des techniques de bilan visuel et de réfraction subjective et objective
- Connaissance des protocoles de dépistage des troubles de la vision binoculaire et de l'accommodation
- Capacité à réaliser des examens complémentaires ophtalmologiques : réfractométrie, périmétrie, et imagerie fonctionnelle
- Aptitude à conduire des séances de rééducation orthoptique auprès de patients de tous âges, de la pédiatrie à la gériatrie
- Connaissance des pathologies relevant du champ orthoptique : strabisme, amblyopie, troubles oculomoteurs, basse vision
- Capacité à travailler en coordination avec les médecins ophtalmologistes dans le cadre de consultations structurées
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de traçabilité et de suivi patient utilisés en cabinet médical
- Rigueur dans la réalisation des actes et sens des responsabilités vis-à-vis des patients
- Qualités relationnelles permettant d'instaurer un climat de confiance avec des patients d'horizons et d'âges variés
- Capacité d'adaptation et volonté de progresser dans un environnement clinique encadré
- Sens de l'organisation pour contribuer à la fluidité des consultations au sein du cabinet

jobs.title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
jobs.description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Our offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and pre-screening requirements. The candidate acknowledges that all information provided must be accurate.

jobs.title: Teacher French Language B (DP and MYP) (m/f) - 6 months contract
jobs.description:
DP (Diploma Programme) and MYP (Middle Years Programme) French Language B - 6 months contract (2627-037)

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

Join Our Learning Community at ISL!

Do you believe that every learner has unique potential, and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking, and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that empower students to make sense of the world and their place in it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a teacher in our school, you will play a key role in shaping not only what our students learn, but how they learn. You'll design engaging, concept-driven lessons that invite curiosity, encourage reflection, and challenge students to connect learning to their own lives — locally and globally. Teaching in our Upper School means that you will be expected to take part in the student wellbeing / advisory programme.
Why ISL?

At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
· Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

About the Role

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:

If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.

If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

jobs.title: Opérateur(trice) de production agroalimentaire (H/F/X)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré
• Vous êtes disponible pour travailler en horaires postés
• Vous maîtrisez le français
• L'anglais et/ou l'allemand constitue un avantage

Nous offrons

• Une entreprise familiale solide et reconnue au niveau européen
• Un environnement industriel moderne en pleine évolution
• Un poste concret, formateur et polyvalent
• Une formation complète à nos procédés et équipements
• Une équipe engagée et un management de proximité
• Une véritable opportunité d'évolution vers un poste de Chef d'équipe Production

Intéressé(e)?
Merci d'envoyer votre candidature (CV + lettre de motivation) à:  benoit.gilson@lesmoulins.lu

jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1167

Apply Now

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your Key Objectives:

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients within BIL, ensuring effective coordination between clients and all relevant internal stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Job Title:  Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction. But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that
 
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.
• Familiarity with data aggregation, reconciliation controls, and risk data quality processes
• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

• Minimum 3 year of experience and strong background in similar role managing risk for AIFs
• Demonstrated expertise in risk management system and reporting operations.

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.

SD-26150-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN CARBON FIBRE SURFACE ENGINEERING AND COMPOSITE MANUFACTURING
Fixed term contract | Hautcharage | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

You will be mainly in charge of:

·        Developing and optimising carbon fibre recovery and recycling processes, with a focus on preserving fibre quality and length.
·        Investigating and optimising fibre surface treatments and sizing strategies to improve fibre–matrix compatibility and interfacial performance.
·        Developing fibre alignment strategies and semi-finished products based on recovered carbon fibres.
·        Manufacturing and optimising recycled carbon fibre composite materials and components using suitable processing routes.
·        Performing mechanical and microstructural characterisation and evaluating structure–process–property relationships.
·        Contributing to the manufacturing and validation of composite demonstrators.
·        Analysing and communicating research results through technical reports, scientific publications and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

·        PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer/Composite Engineering or a closely related field.
·        A strong research background in composite materials, preferably involving surface engineering, carbon-fibre-reinforced polymers and/or recycling.

Experience and skills

·        Strong background in fibre-reinforced polymer composites and composite manufacturing.
·        Experience in carbon fibre recycling, surface treatment and/or sizing.
·        Experience in composite processing and mechanical/material characterisation.
·        Knowledge of fibre alignment and semi-finished product manufacturing would be an asset.
·        Ability to independently plan, conduct and analyse experimental research.
·        Strong communication, scientific writing and teamwork skills.

Language skills

•              Fluency in English, oral and written. Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

·        An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
·        Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
·        Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
·        An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas

·        32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
·        Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Core (Android)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is building the operating system for knowledge work, and we want people to be able to do substantive knowledge work from their phone.

A great native app is what makes that possible. On Android, that means Notion should feel like it was built for the platform: fast to open, smooth to scroll, and reliable offline or on a spotty connection. We’re investing in a more native foundation for how people read, write, and edit in Notion. That lets users capture ideas in the moment, find answers across their workspace, manage tasks and projects, and work with teammates, with the speed, polish, and dependability people expect from the best apps on their phone.

As an Android engineer, you’ll help build that native foundation, from how pages render and how people write and edit, to the navigation and app chrome people use every day, like Home, Search, and Inbox, along with the shared frameworks the rest of the app is built on. You’ll work across the Android stack, with chances to dig into our shared Rust layer and the AI tools we use for mobile development. Along the way, you’ll pair with experienced product and mobile AI engineers to find what slows the team down, try new Android capabilities, and help decide what ships in the app.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Ship the core Notion experience on Android: Build and polish the surfaces people use every day—opening and reading pages, writing and editing, navigating the app, and the Home, Search, and Inbox tabs—on a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose stack that is fast to open, smooth to scroll, and dependable offline.

 - Build with product and design, and iterate fast: Partner with product managers and designers to turn ideas into shipped features, then use feedback and data to make them better. Use AI coding tools and agents to build, test, and investigate faster, while you stay accountable for review, validation, and quality.

 - By the end of your first year, own a core product area: Take a core part of the Android app, like Home, Inbox, or a piece of the editor, from idea to launch, and shape it into an experience that helps people do their life’s work from their phone.

 - Make the app feel fast and reliable: Find and fix issues in startup time, scrolling, typing latency, crashes, and memory use across the surfaces you own, and add the tests and monitoring that catch regressions before users do.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Solid Android fundamentals: You’ve built and shipped Android apps, through work, internships, or your own projects, and you’re comfortable with modern Android—Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and Gradle. Experience with a large, modular codebase is a plus.

 - Care for native UI and performance: You enjoy making UI feel fast and smooth, and you’re curious about things like custom text rendering, complex lazy lists, or rich-text editing. Experience with performance profiling, realtime collaboration, or offline sync is a plus.

 - Product instincts: You care about how the app feels to use, not just how it works. You sweat the details of interactions and polish, and you use feedback and data to decide what to build next.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving and clear communication: You build a clear picture of the problem before jumping to a fix, you can explain trade-offs in writing, and you ask for help early when you’re stuck. Experience moving a hybrid or web-based surface to native, or building something from 0→1, is a plus.

 - AI-native, end-to-end engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective. Web experience (TypeScript, React, Node) is welcome but not required.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THIS JOB

We're looking for a Head of Marketing Strategy & Operations to run the business side of marketing. Our marketing team went from two people to 25 this year, organized around four functions: product marketing, brand and consumer, enterprise, and growth. This is the first operations hire on that team. You'll own the marketing budget with Finance, run our planning cycle and operating cadence, keep hiring aligned with the plan, and partner directly with the CMO on how marketing sets priorities and tells its story to the executive team and the board.

It's a role for someone who has sat close to a CMO and a CFO, likes turning ambiguity into a plan people can execute, and is comfortable building the function themselves before building a team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Budget & Financial Operations

 - Own the marketing budget end to end with Finance: allocation across teams and channels, tracking against plan, forecasting, variance flags, and the tradeoff conversations that follow

 - Build the layer of visibility leadership needs (spend by team, channel, and program) on top of the spend-tracking tools we already have, so decisions get made with numbers

 - Run quarterly, half-year, and annual budget planning, and make marketing's case to Finance and the executive team

 - Own marketing's vendor and agency contracts end to end: evaluations, procurement, renewals, and a clear view of what we pay for and why



Planning & Operating Cadence

 - Own marketing's planning cycle: translate company goals into marketing objectives, OKRs, and resourced plans, and keep them current as priorities shift

 - Bring a point of view. Pressure-test plans, frame the tradeoffs, and help the CMO decide where marketing places its bets

 - Design the lightweight processes and internal tools (planning, intake, reporting) that let a 25-person team operate like a much bigger one

 - Run the operating rhythm for the marketing leadership team: meetings, all-hands, team-wide readouts, agendas, decisions, and follow-through

 - Keep the marketing functions connected so plans, launches, and budgets move together



Executive Partnership

 - Partner directly with the CMO on board materials, executive readouts, and strategy documents. Own first drafts and make them data-backed and on-message

 - Extend the CMO's reach across the team: surface risks early, chase decisions to closure, and keep priorities clear week to week

 - Represent marketing in cross-functional planning with Finance, Sales, and Product



Hiring & Org Operations

 - Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads on headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview process, and keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

 - Standardize the basics across sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards) and help new leaders land well




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years in marketing strategy and operations, business operations, strategic finance, management consulting, or a similar role supporting a CMO, GM, or business unit leader

 - You've owned a sizable marketing or departmental budget end to end and can talk about spend, forecast, and variance the way Finance does

 - You've built or run a planning cycle (annual or half-year, OKRs) and an operating cadence for a leadership team

 - You've drafted board or executive materials for a senior leader and know the difference between a readout and a narrative

 - Experience with headcount planning and hiring operations alongside a Talent team

 - You've run vendor evaluations and procurement alongside Finance and kept a clean view of contracts and renewals

 - Comfortable as an individual contributor. This is the first ops hire; you'll do the work before you have a team

 - You scope light and move fast. We plan in weeks, not quarters, and you build just enough process to keep a fast team aligned

 - You build trust quickly, from individual contributors to the C-suite

 - Bonus: you're comfortable building your own tools with AI. We use Replit to run Replit

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Software Factory
Software Engineer, Mobile Platform (iOS)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the iOS platform that helps engineers ship confidently. As Notion’s mobile team grows, we’re turning the first generation of mobile foundations into a durable platform: clearer architecture, ergonomic testing, dependable observability, and faster CI/CD. This role is broad—you’ll shape the iOS stack end to end, from shared frameworks and build systems to release quality, with opportunities to work across our shared Rust layer and AI infrastructure for mobile development. You’ll pair with mobile AI and core product engineers to understand friction, evaluate new iOS capabilities, and decide what should become part of the platform.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Make the iOS platform agent-ready: Give engineers and agents dependable ways to build, run, test, screenshot, and iterate through the app so mobile teams can move faster without lowering the quality bar.

 - By the end of your first year, define how iOS features are built: establish architecture and ship developer tools, then partner with product engineers to adopt them.

 - Raise the bar for iOS reliability and release quality: Improve the systems that catch regressions, prevent incidents, and help engineers understand issues quickly across builds, tests, observability, and CI/CD.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Deep iOS engineering experience at scale: You’ve helped build and deploy mobile applications used by millions, and understand the reliability, performance, and operational practices required at that scale.

 - Platform or infrastructure experience: You’ve worked below the product-feature layer on mobile CI/CD, testing platforms, build systems, developer tooling, or shared frameworks—and can turn recurring friction into durable systems.

 - Strong architectural judgment: You’re familiar with multiple approaches to iOS architecture and can explain the trade-offs clearly, choosing patterns that make features easier to build, test, and maintain.

 - Cross-functional influence: You can partner closely with product engineers, understand their pain points, and earn adoption for new platform APIs, workflows, and standards without relying on authority.

 - AI-native engineering practice: You use AI tools and agents as real collaborators, framing tasks clearly, reviewing generated changes, testing behavior, and designing workflows that make the broader team more effective.

 

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

In this role, you own the engagement outcome. You will lead our most complex, multi-workstream engagements in Korea, decide when Forward Deployed Engineers are needed for code-intensive work, and coach others to raise the bar across our Services practice.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead Notion’s most complex, multi-workstream customer engagements in Korea end to end, from scoping and discovery through launch, adoption and handoff, often where the future state and success measures are not yet defined.

 - Shape Services scope, effort estimates and implementation strategy with account teams during pre-sales, then deliver against the agreed scope, timeline and outcomes, recovering engagements that go off track.

 - Drive executive alignment on ambiguous, high-stakes decisions: facilitate discovery and architecture workshops, frame tradeoffs clearly and deliver hard messages directly.

 - Decide where Notion should own, complement or connect to existing systems, and design scalable architectures and AI-native workflows to a production quality bar, including permission design, AI evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls and operational ownership.

 - Orchestrate Forward Deployed Engineers, partners and internal teams: define when deeper engineering is required and set clear scope, ownership and handoffs.
